Preheat charcoal grill. Toss wood chips onto coals and reapply grate.
Add chicken and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove to a plate, and let rest 5–10 minutes.
Shred chicken with two forks. Toss with cheese and sprinkle into each tortilla. Roll lengthwise and wait until cheese is melted before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Chocolate Cake with Mocha Buttercream

ingredients.name: cinnamon (increase to 2 teaspoons if using the semisweet chocolate)
ingredients.original: 1 teaspoon cinnamon (increase to 2 teaspoons if using the semisweet chocolate)

ingredients.name: plus 2 white granulated tablespoons sugar
ingredients.original: 1 cup plus 2 white granulated tablespoons sugar

ingredients.name: Cinnamon, unsweetened cocoa, and confectioner's sugar, optional toppings
ingredients.original: Cinnamon, unsweetened cocoa, and confectioner's sugar, optional toppings

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Generously spray a deep 9-inch springform pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Melt the chocolates in a double boiler or in a microwave oven at low power.
Set aside to cool.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon into a medium-size bowl.
Place the butter and sugar in a large mixing bowl and cream at high speed with an electric mixer.
Add the vanilla and the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Pour in the cooled chocolate mixture, and beat well until everything is incorporated.
Add ⅓ of the flour mixture, and stir until it is just barely incorporated, then pour in half the milk.
Stir briefly, then repeat with another ⅓ of the flour and the remaining milk.
Add the rest of the flour mixture and stir just enough to blend. Don't over mix, or the cake will toughen.
Spread into the prepared pan and bake for 55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool completely before assembling and frosting.
Cut the cake into 3 equal layers, using a long serrated knife and a gentle sawing motion.
Spread mocha buttercream between the layers, and stack them evenly.
Spread more buttercream on the sides and the top.
Artfully sprinkle the top with extra cinnamon, cocoa, and confectioner's sugar, if desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Habanero Hot Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth.
Refrigerate in a non-reactive container for up to 2 months.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Ribs

ingredients.name: tequila (recommended: José Cuervo Especial)
ingredients.original: ¼ cup tequila (recommended: José Cuervo Especial)

steps: Combine sugar, chile powders, oregano, salt, and pepper. Remove membrane from ribs and rub both sides with mixture. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to marinate.
Combine tequila, habanero, and sauce. Bring to a boil in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Set aside.
Place enough mesquite chunks in a smoker to keep the temperature at 200°F. Place ribs in smoker and cook 7 hours, basting every hour with sauce mixture.
Brush meat side liberally with sauce mixture. Place sauce side-down on a high grill and cook until well-browned. Brush other side with sauce and repeat 1 more time.
Slice ribs into 1-rib portions and serve warm with remaining sauce.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice I

ingredients.name: tomatoes (if canned, drain them)
ingredients.original: 1 cup chopped tomatoes (if canned, drain them)

steps: Over medium-high heat, fry the dry rice in oil until golden brown, stirring often.
Add onions and green peppers and cook until slightly softened.
Add tomatoes, spices, and water. Cover and cook for 20 minutes on low heat.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice II

ingredients.name: fresh red chile, seeded and finely diced (or 1 dehydrated chile that has been rehydrated)
ingredients.original: 1 fresh red chile, seeded and finely diced (or 1 dehydrated chile that has been rehydrated)

ingredients.name: Ancho Enchilada Sauce, strained through a medium mesh
ingredients.original: 5 tbsp Ancho Enchilada Sauce, strained through a medium mesh

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.original: 4 cloves of garlic, peeled and crushed

ingredients.name: onion, peeled and finely diced
ingredients.original: ½ small onion, peeled and finely diced

steps: Sauté garlic, onions, and red chile in oil over medium heat for about 1 minute.
Add in the rice and stir frequently until rice begins to brown.
Mix chicken stock and chile sauce in another saucepan and bring to a boil. When mixed, make sure liquid mixture equals out to 2 cups of liquid.
Add chicken stock and chile sauce mixture to rice and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and bring rice to slow simmer. Cook for 25–30 minutes with the lid on.
Remove lid and fluff rice with a fork.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice Pilaf
steps: Rinse rice with cold water until water runs clear. Pat dry with paper towels.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add rice and cook until rice turns golden brown.
Meanwhile, combine tequila, broth, tomato, salt, oregano, and pepper. Pour over rice and bring to a boil. Add bay leaves and habanero chiles.
Cook, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes or until rice reaches the desired tenderness.
Remove bay leaves and chiles. Serve warm.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Seasoning
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Store in a cool, dry place.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Tequila Marinade
steps: Combine all ingredients in an 8-ounce mason jar. Keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks. Shake well before using.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mexican Tomato Soup

ingredients.name: tomato sauce, tomato purée, or similar
ingredients.original: About ½ litre tomato sauce, tomato purée, or similar

ingredients.name: vegetable or olive oil
ingredients.original: ¼ cup (60 ml) vegetable or olive oil

ingredients.name: More vegetables according to your taste
ingredients.original: More vegetables according to your taste

steps: Cut onion fine and fry lightly in a large saucepan with a bit of oil.
Add vegetables, roughly in the order you find logical (ie, tomatoes don't take long, peppers can be there from the start).

Add about ½ teaspoon salt, adjusting to taste. The salt will extract water from the vegetables and make them 'stew' faster. You can cover the pot if it goes slowly—once again, this slows the evaporation and allows the vegetables to cook in the water they lose themselves.
Add tomato sauce and corn.

Add salt and sugar to taste. Be bold; tomato sauce takes a lot of salt and at least a heaping teaspoon of sugar to taste right. If unsure, separate a small amount and try adding more salt—you will see the tastes changes significantly.
Serve with tortilla chips, or toasted bread if not available.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mhadjeb (Algerian Stuffed Flatbread)
steps: Dough: Combine the semolina, flour, and salt together in a bowl. Gradually stir in water with your hands until you get a smooth and soft dough.
Wet a plastic bag in warm water, cover the dough while still dripping, and let it rest. Afterwards, uncover the dough and knead lightly for a few minutes.
Coat your hands in oil, and shape the dough into balls, arranging them beside each other. Cover and allow to rest once more. These extra relaxation periods help to produce superior results.
Filling: Peel the tomatoes, then dice them into small pieces.
Heat some oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the onions, and stir regularly until they become translucent and soft.
Add the diced tomatoes, seasonings, and salt. Cover the pan and allow the mixture to cook over low heat, stirring occasionally to prevent it from sticking.
Let cool.
Assembly: On an oiled surface, roll out the first ball of dough and give it a light coating of oil.
Place some filling in the center, and fold the dough over it on four sides to form a square.
Lightly oil the top of the dough and move it to a hot pan over medium-low heat. Cook until the first side is well-browned, then flip it to the other side and brown again. Remove from the pan.
Repeat the shaping and cooking process with the remaining dough and filling.
Serve hot and enjoy!

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave 1-2-3 Cake
steps: Beat the egg until smooth.
Add the honey and milk and mix well.
Add the breadcrumbs and mix until uniform.
Let the mixture sit for a few minutes, to allow the breadcrumbs to absorb the moisture.
Pour the mixture into a small silicone mold (e.g. Dollar store loaf pan).
Microwave on high for 4 minutes or a little after it stops rising.
Allow to cool a little; tip out onto a plate if desired.
Top with more maple syrup or honey, if desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Applesauce

ingredients.name: Grade B Amber maple syrup (Grade A Dark Amber would be okay too)
ingredients.original: ¼ cup Grade B Amber maple syrup (Grade A Dark Amber would be okay too)

steps: Combine all ingredients in a microwave-safe container.
Cover container, leaving 1 corner open, and microwave on high 7–8 minutes or until apples are easy to mash.
Remove cinnamon stick and discard.
For a chunky sauce, mash the apples with a potato masher. For a slightly smoother sauce, use a hand mixer. For a smooth pureé, use an immersion blender.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Cake I

ingredients.name: vegetable oil (soybean or sunflower oils work best)
ingredients.original: 3 Tbsp vegetable oil (soybean or sunflower oils work best)

steps: Mix the dry ingredients well in a small bowl or large mug.
Add the egg and mix thoroughly.
Pour in the milk and oil and mix well.
Add vanilla essence and chocolate chips (if using), mix again.
Pour into two greased 9-inch round baking pans or keep in large mug.
Microwave on high for 3 minutes or until it stops rising.
Allow to cool a little; tip out onto a plate if desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Cake II

ingredients.name: chocolate chips, pine nuts, or hazelnuts
ingredients.original: 3 tbsp (15 ml) chocolate chips, pine nuts, or hazelnuts

steps: Mix all the dry ingredients directly in a microwave-safe mug or bowl.
Add the egg and mix well.
Stir in the milk and oil.
Add the chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir well.
Microwave for 3 minutes at 1000w / 4 minutes at 700w / 3:30 minutes at 750w.
Cool slightly and enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Chip Cookie

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
ingredients.original: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened at room temperature

ingredients.name: light brown sugar
ingredients.original: ¼ cup (45 g / 1.5 oz) light brown sugar

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.original: ½ cup (70 g / 2.5 oz) all-purpose flour

ingredients.name: dark chocolate chips
ingredients.original: ½ cup (40 g / 1.5 oz) dark chocolate chips

steps: Line a large microwave-safe plate with parchment.
Beat the butter and sugar in a small bowl until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Sift the flour and salt and fold into the butter mixture. Fold in most of the chocolate chips.
Scoop the dough into center of plate. Decorate with remaining chocolate chips.
Microwave the cookie for 1.5–2 minutes, depending on microwave's power.
Leave the cookie to cool.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Pudding

ingredients.name: white granulated sugar or sugar substitute
ingredients.original: ⅓ cup (80 g) white granulated sugar or sugar substitute

ingredients.name: unsweetened cocoa powder
ingredients.original: ¼ cup (60 g) unsweetened cocoa powder

ingredients.name: milk or soy milk
ingredients.original: 2 cups (480 ml) milk or soy milk

ingredients.name: vanilla extract or imitation vanilla
ingredients.original: 1 tsp vanilla extract or imitation vanilla

steps: In a 1-qt microwave-safe bowl, mix the dry ingredients together.
Add the cold milk and mix well with a small wire whisk or an electric mixer until all the cocoa lumps have dissolved.
Microwave in the bowl, on high (100%) power, for 3 minutes. Stir well.
Microwave, again on high power, for an additional 4–6 minutes, stirring after each minute of cooking.
Remove the bowl from the microwave oven and stir in the vanilla.
Pour the result into 4 small custard cups and chill before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Lemon Puddings

ingredients.name: homemade or purchased lemon curd
ingredients.original: 6 tablespoons homemade or purchased lemon curd

steps: Grease 4 ea. 150 ml microwave-safe ramekins.
Mix together the lemon curd and water in a bowl.
Spoon the mixture into the ramekins.
Beat the margarine and sugar together in another bowl.
Beat in the egg and lemon zest.
Fold in the flour, then mix in the lemon juice.
Divide the mixture between ramekins and smooth the tops.
Put the ramekins on a plate and microwave for 4 minutes. Let stand 1 minute.
Dust the puddings with powdered sugar and serve, optionally, with raspberries and crème fraîche.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Oat Porridge
steps: Mix water, oat flakes, and salt in a bowl.
Boil on high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Stir and serve immediately.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Lightly grease a cookie sheet and set aside.
In 1½-quart casserole dish, stir together sugar and syrup. Microwave on high for 4 minutes.
Stir in peanuts. Microwave on high for 3–5 minutes or until light brown.
Add butter and vanilla, mixing well. Microwave at high 1–2 minutes more. The peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot.
Add baking soda and stir gently until light and foamy.
Pour mixture onto greased cookie sheet. Let cool ½–1 hour.
When cool, break into small pieces and store in airtight container.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Quesadilla

ingredients.name: meltable shredded cheese (typically Monterey Jack cheese, but others are okay)
ingredients.original: About ¼ cup (30 ml) meltable shredded cheese (typically Monterey Jack cheese, but others are okay)

ingredients.name: Fresh spinach, washed and torn into small pieces
ingredients.original: Fresh spinach, washed and torn into small pieces

ingredients.name: Canned lback beans, rinsed and well drained
ingredients.original: Canned lback beans, rinsed and well drained

steps: Place one tortilla on a microwave-safe plate.
Cover with half the cheese and sprinkle on fillings as desired.
Spread remaining cheese over the toppings, and place second tortilla on top.
Microwave on high power for 30–60 seconds (or until cheese is melted and fillings are warm).
Add desired toppings and enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Risotto

ingredients.name: simmering hot chicken broth
ingredients.original: 3 cups (750 ml/1.6 pints) simmering hot chicken broth

ingredients.name: dash ground white or black pepper
ingredients.original: 1 dash ground white or black pepper

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.original: ½ cup (90 g/3.2 oz) minced yellow onion

ingredients.name: uncooked medium grain rice
ingredients.original: 1 cup (125 g/4.4 oz) uncooked medium grain rice

steps: In a saucepan, bring chicken broth, salt and pepper to a low simmer, and keep warm until needed.
In an 8 × 8 × 2 in oven-proof dish (or 10-inch/25 cm quiche dish), heat oil and butter in microwave for 2 minutes.
Add minced onion to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for 4 minutes.
Add uncooked rice to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for another 4 minutes.
Pour simmering chicken broth into the dish and stir well. Microwave 9 minutes.
Stir rice and chicken broth well and microwave another 9 minutes.
If a creamier risotto is desired, add ¼ cup (60 ml) warm water, stir well and microwave for another 2 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwave Salmon in a Parchment Envelope
steps: Take a 15 x 36-inch piece of parchment paper, and fold it in half like a book. Draw a large half-heart on the paper, with fold of the paper being the center line of the heart. Cut out heart and open.
Place fresh herbs in the bottom of half of the heart. Place 2 lemon slices on top of the herbs and top with the salmon. Sprinkle both sides with salt, paprika, and freshly ground black pepper.
Drizzle salmon with white wine and top evenly with butter cubes. Top with remaining lemon slices.

Fold other side of heart over fish and starting at top of heart shape, fold up both edges of parchment, overlapping folds as you move along. Once you reach the end tip, twist several times to secure tightly.
Place on a microwave-safe plate and microwave on high 4 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 131°F. Open parchment and serve warm.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwaved Artichoke

ingredients.name: Dips, such as drawn butter or mayonnaise
ingredients.original: Dips, such as drawn butter or mayonnaise

steps: Cut off top ⅓ of the artichoke, and all but 1 inch of the stem.
Remove base leaves and cut off the tips of the higher leaves.
Sprinkle artichoke with lemon juice to preserve color.
Place artichoke stem up in a microwave-safe dish tall enough to place lid without touching the artichoke.
Fill dish with 1 inch (3 cm) of water and any of the seasonings.
Cover and microwave on high for 6–8 minutes, and allow to rest for 1–2 minutes. The artichoke is cooked when a paring knife can be inserted into the heart without resistance.
Remove artichoke from the dish and place upside down to drain.
Serve whole, with one or more dips. Diners should remove a leaf, dip the base of the leaf in the dip, and eat the fleshy base of the leaf.
When all the leaves are gone, remove the choke, cut the heart of the artichoke into bite sized pieces, and serve with the dip.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwaved Basmati Rice
steps: Add rice and salt to the rice cooker.
Mix in boiling water, then fit the double lids on.
Cook as follows, stirring halfway through:
700W for 13 minutes, or
750W for 12 minutes, or
800W for 11 minutes, or
850W for 10 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes, then drain in a sieve.
Spread the rice onto an oven paper-lined tray and warming it at a very low setting in a conventional oven. Turn the rice gently from time to time.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Microwaved Scrambled Egg
steps: Crack the eggs and butter in a coffee cup.
Microwave on high power for 30 seconds.
Remove from the microwave, stir, and replace.
Cook for another 30 seconds on high.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Lamb Kabobs

ingredients.name: leg of lamb (shank end), cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes
ingredients.original: 1 pound (450 g) leg of lamb (shank end), cut into 1½ inch cubes

steps: Combine all ingredients except lamb in a gallon size zip-top bag. Add lamb cubes and toss to coat; refrigerate overnight to marinate.
The next day, drain lamb and discard marinade.
Thread 4 lamb cubes onto one skewer. Repeat until all lamb has been skewered.
Fire up a charcoal grill for 15 minutes. Add lamb and cook 8 minutes per side for medium rare.
Serve warm with couscous.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Meatballs

ingredients.name: packed cilantro, chopped coriander
ingredients.original: ¼ cup packed cilantro, chopped coriander

ingredients.name: packed flat-leaf parsley
ingredients.original: ¼ cup packed flat-leaf parsley, chopped

steps: In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, garlic, and mint. Season to taste with salt.
Set the broiler rack 5 inches from the heat.
Preheat the broiler.
In a mixing bowl, combine the meat, rice, onion, cilantro, parsley, cinnamon, cumin, red and black peppers, and ½ teaspoon salt, stirring mixture with a fork until it is well blended
With your hands, form the mixture into 1½-inch meatballs.
As you make them, place the meatballs on a baking sheet that fits under the broiler.
Broil the meatballs until they are well browned on top, 4 to 5 minutes.
Using tongs, turn and cook until the meatballs are browned outside and no longer pink in the center, 3–4 minutes.
Transfer them to a serving plate and serve warm, passing the yogurt sauce in a bowl.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Midwestern Chicken Wings

ingredients.name: apricot preserves (not preserved apricots, not apricot jelly)
ingredients.original: 12 ounces apricot preserves (not preserved apricots, not apricot jelly)

steps: Place all ingredients except chicken into a bowl and mix to make a marinade.

Marinate the chicken in the refrigerator with the marinade for at least 3 hours. A plastic bag sealed tight without much air or free space is believed to provide the best marinating. As with many marinating recipes, the longer the better.
Clean and preheat grill to medium heat.
Place wings on grill. Turn 1–4 times over the next 20 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mieliepap (South African Maize Porridge)
steps: Add boiling water from the kettle to a pot, and bring to a boil again.
Mix the maize meal and cold water in a separate bowl to form a thick mixture.
Add the cold mixture and salt to the boiling pot of water, and stir until the soft porridge starts bubbling and is thick.
Reduce the heat to low, and partially close the lid. Cook for 20 minutes.
Serve with margarine, milk, and/or sugar if desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mild Salty Lassi

ingredients.name: mint (finely crumbled, dried; optional)
ingredients.original: ¼ teaspoon mint (finely crumbled, dried; optional)

steps: Dry-roast cumin seeds by cooking them over low heat in a small pan until you can smell the seasoning (about 2–3 minutes). Cool and grind.
In blender, blend cumin seed powder with yoghurt, milk, lemon juice, salt, and ice cubes.
Serve chilled, optionally garnished with crumbled mint and a small pinch of cayenne.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Milk Chocolate Pepper Vodka Tart

ingredients.name: roasted red bell peppers, packed in oil
ingredients.original: 2 roasted red bell peppers, packed in oil

ingredients.name: milk chocolate, cut into pieces
ingredients.original: 10 ounces milk chocolate, cut into pieces

steps: Crust: Place sugar, butter, egg and vanilla in a mixing bowl, and mix at low speed until combined.
Add flour and mix until incorporated; do not over mix.
Set the dough on a floured cookie pan and press flat.
Refrigerate until firm enough to roll out, 45 minutes to an hour.
After making filling, line an 11-inch cake pan with the crust.
Line the bottom of the unbaked tart shell with a single thin layer of red bell peppers that have been wiped free of most of the oil.
Filling: Melt chocolate and butter over low heat in a saucepan.
Stir in vanilla.
Take off the heat and add pepper vodka and let cool slightly.
While the chocolate mixture is cooling, whip the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy.
Fold into cooled chocolate mixture.
Sift the flour into this mixture, making sure there are no lumps.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Pour chocolate mixture on top of red bell pepper layer, leaving ¾ inch at the top of pan.
Bake for about 20 minutes. The center should be soft, similar to a pumpkin pie when it is done.
Let cool before taking it out of the pan.
Refrigerate overnight before cutting.
Topping: Whip cream and confectioners' sugar until peaks are thick, then slowly whip in vodka.
When vodka is completely mixed in, add melted white chocolate while whisking.
Refrigerate for 4 hours.
Top each piece with plenty of whipped cream, sprinkle lightly with nutmeg and enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Milk Toast I

ingredients.name: pint (570 ml) milk, part cream if the person is not forbidden that
ingredients.original: 1 pint (570 ml) milk, part cream if the person is not forbidden that

steps: Heat the milk to the simmering point.
Generously butter the toast slices.
Heat a pretty bowl, deeper than it is wide. Break the hot buttered toast into it, pour the steaming but not boiling milk over it, sprinkle a little salt and pepper on the top, and serve at once.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Milk Toast II
steps: Gradually add cold water to flour to make a smooth, thin paste.
Add paste to milk, stirring constantly until thickened.
Cover, and cook 20 minutes; then, add salt and butter in small pieces.
Dip slices of toast separately in sauce; when soft, remove to serving dish. Pour remaining sauce over all.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mince Pie Tartlets with Pork

ingredients.name: cored and sliced apples (from about 12 large apples)s
ingredients.original: 800 g cored and sliced apples (from about 12 large apples)s

steps: Preheat oven to 150 °C (300 °F).
In a pot, bring the sugar, wine, cider, orange, and lemon juice to a simmer. Add mace, nutmeg, and cinnamon. Split the vanilla pod and scrape seeds into pot. Discard vanilla pod.
Stir in sliced apples and fruit mix.
Grease the muffin tins, and line with pastry dough to make tartlet cases. Trim to fit.
Place cases into oven, and bake until lightly golden. Remove from oven and let cool.
Melt butter in a pan. Add minced pork, and sauté until browned.
Remove cinnamon stick from the fruit mixture, and mix in the pork.
Using a tablespoon, fill tartlet cases with the filling—it will probably be mounded.
If desired, trim with excess pastry.
Bake each tray at 120 °C (250 °F) for half an hour.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mince Pie with Meat I

ingredients.name: butter, lard, or vegetable shortening
ingredients.original: 454 g (1 lb) butter, lard, or vegetable shortening, diced

ingredients.name: cored and sliced apples
ingredients.original: 1815 g (4 lb) cored and sliced apples

ingredients.name: citrus fruit (e.g. orange), zested and juiced
ingredients.original: 1 citrus fruit (e.g. orange), zested and juiced

steps: Sear diced beef in a pan until well-coloured (this can be done in batches). Set aside until cool.
Combined all ingredients except dough in a bowl. Mix well (this step can be done in batches).
Use the pastry dough to line 3 deep, greased pie pans (or 5 greased muffin pans, for tartlets) and create pie shells.
Place shells into oven and set to 150 °C (300 °F). Bake until lightly golden. Remove from oven and let rest until cooled.
Fill pie shells with filling mixture until level or slightly mounded above the rim. Trim with excess pastry.
Bake at 150 °C (300 °F) for 45 minutes per tray (or 35 minutes per muffin tray).

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mincemeat

ingredients.name: seedless black raisins
ingredients.original: 2 cups (160 g/5.6 oz) seedless black raisins

ingredients.name: meat stock
ingredients.original: 1 ½ cups (375 ml/12.7 oz) meat stock

ingredients.name: sorghum molasses or regular molasses
ingredients.original: 1 ½ cups (500 g/1.1 lb) sorghum molasses or regular molasses

steps: Core apples; remove the seeds, but don’t peel.
Cube meat and cover with water. Simmer until tender; this may take up to an hour.
Remove meat and cook the stock down to the amount needed, or thicken slightly with cornstarch.
Run meat through a food mill (medium or coarse blade), or grind to an equivalent fineness in a food processor.
Cut lemon in half and remove seeds. Purée the whole lemon in a blender, rind and all, with some of the liquid ingredients, or process as finely as possible in a food processor.
Grind the apples (or process using a coarse blade—but not too fine).
Combine the apple, meat, and raisins in a large, heavy-bottomed pot.
Add the sugar, spices, liquids, and lemon purée to the meat and apples. Use hot meat stock to rinse the last of the molasses into the mixture. Stir thoroughly.

Cook slowly, uncovered, stirring often to prevent burning until the mixture is pasteurized and enough of the liquids have evaporated to produce the texture and thickness you want in the finished mixture.
Let cool, then stir in the ground pepper.
Refrigerate, allowing the spices to mellow for several weeks.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Minestra
steps: Combine the courgettes, aubergines, pumpkin, onion, and kohlrabi in a large pot or pressure cooker. Add the vegetable stock and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Bring to pressure and cook for 8–10 minutes, or simmer for 1 hour. Cool, then purée the whole thing.
Place a large handful of basil leaves and about 6 cloves of garlic in a mortar and pound until roughly crushed and a gritty paste is achieved. Add to the pot, stir and season to taste.
Meanwhile, boil the beans separately until soft, then add to purée mixture.
Boil the pasta until al dente then add to mixture.
Serve with grated Parmesan or hard Edam sprinkled over it.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Minestrone alla Capucina
steps: Pound anchovy.
Fry it in butter with the onion and rice until the rice is golden brown.
Remove the onion and season with salt.
Gradually add some stock, cooking until the dish is of the consistency of rice pudding.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Minestrone alla Casalinga
steps: Blanch vegetables in boiling salted water, then drain them and fry in butter.
Add plenty of good stock, and put over low heat.
Boil rice in stock until well-done. Add the stock and vegetables.
Season with minestrone seasoning condiment, and serve with grated cheese handed separately.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mini English Muffin Pizzas
steps: Slice English muffins in half.
Spoon 1 tbsp pizza sauce on each English muffin half and spread evenly.
Place 4 pepperoni slices on each English muffin half.
Cover each mini pizza with ¼ cup mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10 minutes/
Let cool then eat.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mini Herb Baguettes
steps: Combine flour, yeast, salt, powdered oregano, rosemary powder, and thyme.
Gradually mix the water into the flour, kneading until elastic. Let stand 30 minutes.
Weigh out 100 grams of dough, and let rest for 10 minutes. Shape the dough into a long loaf. Repeat with remaining dough.
Transfer loaves to a baking sheet sprinkled with flour. Make slices in the top with a sharp knife or blade. Let rise 50 minutes until fluffy.
Spray loaves with water. Bake 25 minutes in a 200°C oven until cooked through.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mini Three-Cheese English Muffin Pizzas

ingredients.name: English muffins, split and buttered
ingredients.original: 6 large English muffins, split and buttered

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Sprinkle buttered muffins with Parmesan cheese.
Toast under broiler until golden brown.
Place 1½ tablespoons of shredded cheddar cheese on each muffin.
Cut frankfurters crosswise in ¼-inch slices; arrange on muffins.
Top each with about 2 tablespoons of pizza sauce, and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of mozzarella cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mint Tea
steps: Boil the water in a kettle.
Pour the boiling water into the teapot.
Put the mint leaves in the teapot. Let steep for several minutes.
Pour some hot tea in a cup and dilute with additional water. Even if it starts to look transparent, the taste is still there.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mirepoix Sauce

ingredients.name: a bunch of herbs (such as parsley, thyme, sage, rosemary)
ingredients.original: a bunch of herbs (such as parsley, thyme, sage, rosemary)

steps: Combine bacon, ham, carrot, onions, herbs, mushrooms, cloves, and peppercorns in a stew pan.
Add the stock and Chablis.
Boil rapidly for 10 minutes, then simmer until it is reduced to a third of its former volume.
Pass through a sieve and use for masking meat, fowl, fish, etc.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mirliton Casserole

ingredients.name: to large green bell pepper
ingredients.original: 1 medium to large green bell pepper, diced

ingredients.name: whole shrimp, peeled OR 1/2 lb (250 g) ground beef
ingredients.original: 1 lb (500 g) whole shrimp, peeled OR ½ lb (250 g) ground beef (optional)

ingredients.name: stick (1/2 cup / 113 g) butter (olive oil may be substituted)
ingredients.original: 1 stick (½ cup / 113 g) butter (olive oil may be substituted)

steps: Place mirliton halves seed-side up in a microwave- or oven-safe dish with approximately 1 inch (2.5cm) of water in the dish. Cover with foil (for oven) or plastic wrap (for microwave) and cook in oven (350°F/175°C) or microwave (high at 10 minute intervals) until mirliton are soft enough to stick a fork or knife through easily. Allow mirliton to cool enough to be handled and dice into large pieces.
Sauté onion, celery, and garlic in butter over medium heat, adding garlic to sauté just before onion, celery, and garlic are fully softened.
Add shrimp or beef to pan until beef is lightly browned or until shrimp is just turning pink. Skip this step if you aren't adding meat.
Incorporate mirliton and bay leaf and allow to simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Remove from heat and add salt, pepper, and parsley to taste. Pour mixture into a casserole dish and cover with bread crumbs.
Bake in the oven at 350°F (175°C) until the mirliton is bubbling and the bread crumbs are browned.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mishkaki (East African Meat Skewers)
steps: Whisk together the vinegar, oil, water, thyme, spices, ginger paste, and garlic paste to make a marinade.
Add the meat and toss well, then transfer everything to a large ziplock bag. Seal the bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 24–48 hours.
Take the meat out of the refrigerator, and give it at least an hour to come to room temperature.
Thread the meat on the skewers.
Preheat a charcoal grill for some time.
Grease the grill grate, and place the skewers on the grate. Cook until medium-done (internal temperature of 65°C / 145°F).
Serve hot with fresh coriander.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mishti Doi (Bengali Sweetened Yogurt)
steps: Place a heavy-bottomed pan on the heat. Add milk, and warm it on medium heat.
Keep aside ⅓ of the sugar and add the rest of sugar to the milk.
Reduce the heat and continue to heat the milk until it reduces by half. Remove from the heat and and keep aside.
Add the remaining sugar to another pan over medium heat. Allow the sugar to get warm and then melt. You will gradually notice the sugar browning and caramelizing.
When it gets to the point of a golden bubbly mixture, add a tablespoon of water in the caramelized sugar and then pour this mixture into the heavy-bottomed pan with milk. Stir well until combined.
Once milk cools off, add the whisked yoghurt, stir well and pour the mixture into earthen pots.
Let the doi set in a warm place for few hours. Once set, refrigerate and serve chilled.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Miso Soup

ingredients.name: cake tofu (optional), cut into 1/2-inch cubes
ingredients.original: ½ cake tofu (optional), cut into ½-inch cubes

steps: Heat oil in a small pot.
Add green onion. Cook for a few minutes while stirring frequently.
Add 2 ½ cups of water. Bring to a boil.
Dissolve miso in remaining ½ cup of water and add to pot.
Lower heat and add mushrooms, seaweed, and tofu, if desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Misro (Indonesian Palm Sugar Cassava Fritters)

ingredients.name: gula melaka palm sugar, broken into small pieces
ingredients.original: 25 g gula melaka palm sugar, broken into small pieces

steps: Combine the cassava, coconut, and salt to form a dough.
Take a small scoop of the dough, and use your hands to roll it into a ball.
Use your thumb to make a divot in the ball, and pinch around it to make a pocket.
Insert a piece of the sugar into the pocket, then pinch the dough around it to fully enclose it.
Roll the finished dumpling in your hands to shape it into a ball again.
Heat enough oil for shallow- or deep-frying in a skillet or pot over medium heat. If you're monitoring the temperature, 350°F (180°C) is a good target.
Gently place the dough balls in the oil, working in batches if needed to avoid crowding the pan. Fry on all sides, turning as necessary, until golden brown all over and cooked through.
Use a slotted spoon or spider to remove the fritters from the oil. Drain them on a rack or paper towels.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mixed Pickled Vegetables (Acar Campur)

ingredients.name: fresh red pepper, seeded and sliced
ingredients.original: 1 fresh red pepper, seeded and sliced

ingredients.name: -inch piece of fresh turmeric or 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
ingredients.original: 1-inch piece of fresh turmeric or 1 teaspoon ground turmeric

ingredients.name: corn, sunflower, or olive oil
ingredients.original: ¼ cup corn, sunflower, or olive oil

steps: Place the pepper, onion, garlic, shrimp paste, nuts, and turmeric in a food processor. Blend to a paste-like consistency.

Heat the processed paste mixture in the oil for 2 minutes. Add the vinegar, water, sugar and salt. Bring to a boil while stirring. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, while preparing vegetables.

Cut carrots into desired bite-sized shapes. Cut green beans into short, even lengths. Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Peel seeded cucumber and cut into bite-sized cubes. Cut cabbage into bite-sized pieces.
Blanch each vegetable separately in boiling water for 1 minute. Rinse in cold water to halt the cooking. Drain well.
Add the vegetables to the boiled paste sauce. Gradually bring the entire mixture to a boil. Cook for 5–10 minutes. Do not overcook—the vegetables should still be crunchy.
Remove from heat. Add the peanuts to the mixture and cool.
Once cool, cover and chill for at least 3 days before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Miyan Karkashi (Nigerian Sesame Leaf Soup)

ingredients.name: karkashi leaves, either fresh or dried and ground
ingredients.original: ½ cup karkashi leaves, either fresh or dried and ground

steps: Grind the karkashi leaves to a paste.
Bring the water to boil in a pot, and stir in the fermented locust beans.
Add the fish and meat, and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Add the karkashi leaf paste along with the potash. Stir, and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the seasoning cube. Continue stirring with a whisk for 3 minutes until the mixture is smooth.
Serve the soup with tuwo masara, tuwo dawa, tuwo alkama, or tuwo shinkafa.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Miyan Kubewa (Okra Soup)

ingredients.name: beef, goat, or assorted meat (optional: cow tripe, kidney, or liver)
ingredients.original: 500 g beef, goat, or assorted meat (optional: cow tripe, kidney, or liver)

ingredients.name: ea. smoked fish or dried fish
ingredients.original: 1–2 ea. smoked fish or dried fish (optional)

ingredients.name: fresh chopped or grated okra (or 1 1/2 cups dried okra)
ingredients.original: 2 cups fresh chopped or grated okra (or 1½ cups dried okra)

ingredients.name: Fresh or dried ground Scotch bonnet chile (to taste)
ingredients.original: Fresh or dried ground Scotch bonnet chile (to taste)

steps: In a pot, combine your cleaned meat, chopped onions, seasoning cubes, and a pinch of salt. Add a little water and simmer until the meat is cooked through and tender to your taste. This can take a while for tough cuts of meat.
If using smoked or dried fish, add it along with the ground locust beans (dawadawa). Allow it to simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Pour in the palm oil and stir well. Let it cook for a few minutes to combine the flavors.
Stir in the okra. If using dried okra, you may need to add some extra water. Stir continuously to encourage the characteristic "draw" (slippery texture).
Sprinkle in the ground crayfish and pepper. Adjust salt and seasoning to taste.
Allow the soup to simmer for another 5–10 minutes. Avoid overcooking the okra to maintain its texture.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Miyan Kuka (Baobab Leaf Soup)
steps: Soak the dried fish in cold water. Debone when soft.
Grind the crayfish with dawadawa. Pound the pepper.
Cook the cow ribs with water, stock cube, salt, and onions until the meat is tender. Remove the onions, then the beef, reserving the stock in the pot.
Stir the kuka powder into the reserved stock until smooth, with no lumps.
Stir in pounded pepper, crayfish and dawa dawa mixture, and palm oil.
Add the deboned fish, cover, and cook 5 minutes over medium heat.
Stir in beef, and add salt to taste. Cook for 2 minutes.
Serve with tuwo shinkafa or tuwo masara.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Miyan Lalo (Hausa Jute Leaf Soup)

ingredients.name: dried ground chile pepper (adjust to taste)
ingredients.original: ½ cup dried ground chile pepper (adjust to taste)

ingredients.name: fresh jute (lalo) leaves
ingredients.original: 2 bunches of fresh jute (lalo) leaves, chopped

ingredients.name: pieces of daddawa (fermented locust bean), pounded
ingredients.original: 2 medium pieces of daddawa (fermented locust bean), pounded

steps: In a pot, boil the meat with the stock cube, half of the chopped onion, and just enough water to cover the meat. Cook until the meat is tender.
Add the chopped jute leaves and potash. Cook for 5–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend the remaining onion with the chile pepper and a small amount of water to form a purée. Add this mixture to the pot along with the pounded daddawa.
Stir well and simmer for another 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Serve hot with tuwo (e.g., Tuwon Semo, Tuwon Masara, Tuwon Shinkafa, Semovita or Fufu).

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Miyan Shuwaka (Hausa Bitter Leaf Soup)

ingredients.name: fresh red chile pepper, puréed
ingredients.original: 2 pieces fresh red chile pepper, puréed

steps: If using fresh bitter leaf, wash with salt and squeeze to reduce the bitterness.
Boil the meat in a pot of water for a few minutes until cooked through. Remove the meat and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, and add the palm oil. Add the onion, pepper, and tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Combine the cooked purée, meat, and bitterleaf in a pot. Add enough water to cover everything.
Add the daddawa, stir the soup well, and cook for 3 more minutes over low heat.
Season with salt to taste and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Miyan Taushe (Hausa Pumpkin Soup)

ingredients.name: palm oil or groundnut oil
ingredients.original: 2–3 tablespoons palm oil or groundnut oil

ingredients.name: spinach, ugu leaf, or yakuwa leaf
ingredients.original: 1 cup chopped spinach, ugu leaf, or yakuwa leaf (optional)

steps: Place the meat in a pot. Add chopped onion, seasoning cubes, salt, and enough water to cover everything. Simmer until the meat is cooked through and tender to your taste—this can take a while for tough cuts of meat.
Add pumpkin chunks to the pot. Cook until they become soft (about 10–15 minutes), then gently mash some of the pumpkin to thicken the soup.
Add groundnut paste if using, daddawa, palm oil, chile pepper, and fish. Stir well and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Add your leafy vegetables and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add water if needed to get your desired soup thickness.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mmong ikong (water leaf soup)
steps: 1. Wash and chop all the water leaf thoroughly. 2. Clean and prepare the fish, stockfish, and periwinkle 3. Cook your fish and stockfish in a separate pot. 4. Place the cooking pot on fire on medium heat. 5. Allow the pot to dry, pour in your plam oil and leave it to hot for about a minute. 6. Add chopped onions into the hot oil and strir. 7. Add in your chopped water leaf and stir, cover the pot and allow it to fry for at least 40 second. 8. Pour in your brout,add fish, stock,paper, and seasoning cubes or powder, stir and allow it to cook for a minute 9. Pour in the periwinkle and add a little water sine the water leaf already has water of it's own. 10. Cover the pot and let it cook for about 3-5 minutes 11. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. 12. Remove from heat and serve hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Moambe (Palm Nut Soup)

ingredients.name: palm nuts (either fresh, frozen, or canned)
ingredients.original: 2 cups palm nuts (either fresh, frozen, or canned)

ingredients.name: meat (chicken, beef, or goat), cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.original: 1–2 pounds meat (chicken, beef, or goat), cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen okra
ingredients.original: 1 cup fresh or frozen okra, chopped

ingredients.name: pumpkin or spinach leaves
ingredients.original: 1–2 cups pumpkin or spinach leaves, chopped

ingredients.name: scotch bonnet or habanero peppers, deseeded and chopped (adjust to your desired spiciness)
ingredients.original: 1–2 scotch bonnet or habanero peppers, deseeded and chopped (adjust to your desired spiciness)

steps: If using fresh palm nuts, crack them open and remove the kernels.
Place the kernels in a pot, cover them with water, and bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes to soften the nuts.
Drain the nuts and transfer them to a blender or food processor. Add a cup of water and blend until smooth. Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any remaining solids. Set aside.
In the same pot, heat the red palm oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and minced garlic. Sauté until fragrant and translucent.
Add the meat pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Season with ground ginger, ground garlic, ground black pepper, and salt. Stir well to coat the meat evenly.
Pour the strained palm nut mixture into the pot with the meat. Stir well to combine. Add enough water to achieve your desired consistency. Moambe is typically thick, so adjust accordingly.
Cover the pot and let the soup simmer on low heat for about 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Add the chopped okra, pumpkin or spinach leaves, and flaked smoked fish (if using). Stir gently to combine.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet or habanero peppers, adjusting the quantity to suit your taste.
Sprinkle in the ground crayfish (if using) and stir again. Continue simmering the soup for an additional 10–15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Taste the soup and adjust the salt and spices according to your preference. Once the flavors have melded and the soup has thickened, it is ready to be served.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mocha Buttercream

ingredients.name: confectioner's sugar (possibly a little more)
ingredients.original: 3½ cups confectioner's sugar (possibly a little more)

ingredients.name: very strong brewed coffee
ingredients.original: ½ cup very strong brewed coffee

steps: Combine butter, confectioner's sugar, cocoa, vanilla, and coffee in a medium-large bowl, mixing slowly until everything is moistened.
Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until uniform and fluffy.
If it seems a little too wet to spread, you can beat in up to ½ cup additional confectioner's sugar.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mocha Delight

ingredients.name: bag Dove Rich Dark Chocolate Hearts
ingredients.original: 1 bag Dove Rich Dark Chocolate Hearts

steps: Base: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Line bottom of 9-inch springform pan with waxed paper; grease.
Add melted butter to graham cracker crumbs and press into bottom of pan.
Prepare brownie mix according to package instructions; spread over crumbs.
Bake until firm, approximately 35 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven to a wire rack; cool completely and remove from pan.
Frosting: Whisk egg whites and sugar together in a bowl over simmering water until sugar is dissolved.
Remove from heat; using electric mixer, whip until fluffy and cooled.
Add butter one nugget at a time while continuing to beat.
Dissolve espresso powder in warm water.
Beat espresso into frosting.
Frost top and sides of cake.
Finishing: Snip small corner of a resealable plastic bag; place whipped cream inside.
Pipe 3 rosettes around outside edges of cake.
Place a chocolate heart atop each rosette.
Place 8 chocolate hearts in a small resealable plastic bag.
Microwave until melted, about 15 seconds.
Cut a corner of the bag; randomly drizzle chocolate on dessert plates.
Place a cake wedge on each plate.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mocha Icing
steps: An hour before baking the cake, take the butter out of the refrigerator to reach room temperature.
Cream the butter.
Add the cocoa and liquids alternately. Then. add the sugar alternately with the liquids.
Stop at spreading consistency even if you have not used all the sugar.
Spread on a hot milk cake or other cake.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mock Béarnaise Sauce

ingredients.name: shallot or small onion, very finely minced OR 1/4 tsp onion powder
ingredients.original: 1 shallot or small onion, very finely minced OR ¼ tsp onion powder

ingredients.name: fresh tarragon, minced OR 1/2 tsp dried tarragon
ingredients.original: 1 tbsp fresh tarragon, minced OR ½ tsp dried tarragon

steps: If using onion powder and dried tarragon, combine them with 2 tbsp water in a microwaveable measuring cup or small bowl. Microwave for about 6 seconds, then set aside.
Soften the butter in the microwave, stopping the oven every 5 seconds to mash and stir the butter until it is very soft but not liquid.
In a small bowl or glass measuring cup, microwave the mayonnaise for 5 seconds.
Remove mayonnaise from the microwave, and beat in the butter a teaspoonful at a time.
Stir in the onion, tarragon, and pepper.
Test the temperature; if it is not warm enough, heat it for 6 seconds at a time in the microwave, stirring each time. Do not overheat or it might separate; it should be warm not hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mock Hollandaise Sauce I

ingredients.name: sticks butter (170 g or 3/4 cup), cut into small pieces
ingredients.original: 1½ sticks butter (170 g or ¾ cup), cut into small pieces

steps: Heat the butter until it melts, taking care not to burn the butter. Once melted, allow to cool until solids appear on the top.
Skim off the milk solids, and keep the clarified butter warm/liquid (in a hot cup will do fine).
Put egg yolks, lemon juice, water, salt and cayenne pepper into a non-reactive saucepan, and beat until smooth.
Heat over very low heat, beating constantly with a whisk. If the egg starts to solidify, remove from heat, and do not stop whisking.

When the whisk forms streaks in the bottom of the pan (around 8 minutes), add clarified butter, one teaspoon at a time to begin with, adding more as it combines. Adding the butter too quickly will make the sauce split, and you will have to start over. The sauce should thicken as butter is added—when it is the desired thickness, remove from the heat.
Add optional parsley and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mock Hollandaise Sauce II
steps: Melt the butter—it should not get brown, just melted.
Add the cream and the egg yolks.
Add the pepper and the nutmeg.
Heat up with a finger in the sauce and do not stop mixing.
When you cannot bear the heat, remove from the heat and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Modern Reuben Sandwich

ingredients.name: cooked corned beef or deli corned beef or pastrami
ingredients.original: 12 oz thinly sliced cooked corned beef or deli corned beef or pastrami

ingredients.name: rye or pumpernickel or sourdough bread
ingredients.original: 8 slices rye or pumpernickel or sourdough bread

steps: Lightly spread butter on one side of each bread slice.
Heat large non-stick skillet over medium heat until hot.
Place 2 bread slices, butter side down, in skillet.
Top each bread slice with 2 slices cheese, 1 tablespoon dressing, 3 ounces corned beef, and ¼ of the sauerkraut.
Top sandwich with bread slice, butter side up.
Cook sandwiches 4–6 minutes or until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, turning once.
Repeat with remaining sandwiches.
Serve with additional Thousand Island dressing, if desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mofletta (Maghrebi Pancake)

ingredients.name: olive oil, plus a little extra for pan-frying
ingredients.original: 2 tbsp of olive oil, plus a little extra for pan-frying

steps: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the water. Let rest in a warm place for 10–15 minutes.
Combine flour, salt, and 1 tablespoon of oil in a bowl. Stir in the yeast mixture to make a dough.
Knead the dough on a flat, flour-dusted surface until smooth and elastic.
Return dough to the bowl and pour the remaining tablespoon of oil onto it, rolling the dough in the bowl until it becomes oiled.
Cover the dough with a tea towel and leave in a warm place until it rises.
Divide the dough into smaller equal portions, and begin to roll the rounded portions out on an oiled work-surface, making them as thin as possible.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat, and grease the bottom with a little oil.
Fry the rolled-out dough portions one at a time until they are lightly browned on one side. Flip over and cook until browned on the second side.
Keep the finished mofletta in a stack, covered with a cloth to retain heat and moisture.
Serve with butter and honey.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mohingha (Burmese Fish Noodle Soup)
steps: In a large bowl, mix sunflower oil, garlic cloves, soup powder, and lemonade for 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix boiling water, diced jalapeño peppers, and ketchup for 5 minutes.
Combine both mixtures, and continue mixing for 2 ½ minutes.
Add rice vermicelli to the bowl; cover it and wait for 10 minutes.
Top it with toppings as desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookies

ingredients.name: milk (minus 1/2 tablespoon for the vinegar)
ingredients.original: ½ cup milk (minus ½ tablespoon for the vinegar)

steps: Grease or parchment-line some cookie sheets.
Combine the vinegar and milk.
Combine the baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, and 2½ cups of flour.
Cream together the sugar and shortening until well-combined, then beat in the molasses and egg until smooth.
Alternately mix in the dry and milk mixtures, starting and ending with the dry mixture.

Bit by bit, mix in more flour as needed. For drop cookies, you might not add any more. For rolled cookies produced without refrigeration, you are likely to need an extra 1½ cup for a total of 4 cups. Refrigeration can reduce this slightly.
Chill the batter in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Form the cookies.
If making drop cookies, scoop some batter onto the prepared cookie sheet. Using a bit of sugar to prevent sticking, squish the cookie with a glass. Press some toppings into the top of the cookie.

Plop a pint-sized blob of batter onto a flour-dusted surface. Dust the top of the dough with flour as you squish it down, then roll it out. A cold marble rolling pin is suggested. Cut out shapes, then place them on the cookie sheet. The unused dough may be put back into the mix; note that this increases the proportion of flour.
Bake cookies for 8–10 minutes at 375°F.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Molasses Taffy
steps: Combine molasses, sugar, vinegar and water in a heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Cook to 255–270°F (124–132°C). The hotter the syrup, the harder the final taffy will be.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, cream of tartar, and baking soda.
Pour into buttered pan or onto marble surface, and let cool slightly.

When cool and thick enough to handle, grease your hands. Grab the candy mixture with both hands, and stretch it apart while twisting slightly. Repeat this process, pulling and twisting the candy until light in color. This pulling and twisting process incorporates air and lightens the candy.
Cut into 1-inch pieces; wrap in squares of waxed paper.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Molasses-Glazed Pork Chops
steps: Place pork chops in a large zip-top bag. Combine liquid ingredients and pour into bag. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Take pork out of marinade. Combine dry seasonings and rub on pork. Heat your grill as high as it will go.
Boil marinade for 10 minutes.
Place pork on grill and cook 2 minutes, brushing with marinade, before rotating 90 degrees to get nice grill marks. Cook another 2 minutes, brushing.
Flip to the other side and repeat. Remove from grill and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve with additional marinade.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Molokhia (Egyptian Jute Mallow Soup)

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen jute mallow (molokhia) leaves
ingredients.original: 2 cups fresh or frozen jute mallow (molokhia) leaves

ingredients.name: Cooked rice or bread
ingredients.original: Cooked rice or bread for serving

steps: If using fresh molokhia leaves, remove any tough stems and wash the leaves thoroughly. If using frozen molokhia, thaw it according to the package instructions.
In a saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and the garlic becomes fragrant.
Add the fresh or thawed molokhia leaves to the saucepan and stir well to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Pour in the vegetable or chicken broth, ensuring that the molokhia leaves are fully submerged.
Season the soup with ground cumin, salt, and black pepper to taste. Stir to incorporate the spices.
Bring the soup to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for about 20–30 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Remove the soup from the heat. Optionally, squeeze the juice of a lemon into the soup and stir well to enhance the flavors.
Serve the molokhia hot, accompanied by cooked rice or bread.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread I

ingredients.name: biscuit dough, each biscuit cut into quarters
ingredients.original: 4 cans of biscuit dough, each biscuit cut into quarters

steps: Combine cinnamon and sugar for rolling.
Roll biscuit sections in sugar mixture, placing in greased bundt pan or high-sided cake pan. Do not pack tightly.
Bring glaze ingredients to a boil, then pour over the dough in the pan.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 40–50 minutes.
Invert onto plate, and serve warm.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread II

ingredients.name: tubes of refrigerated Pillsbury Buttermilk Biscuits
ingredients.original: 4 tubes of refrigerated Pillsbury Buttermilk Biscuits

steps: Use cooking spray to fully grease inside of a bundt pan. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).

Take biscuits out of can. Notice that they're cut up into 8 sections. Use scissors to cut each section into quarters, so that you have 4 pieces with each section. This should be a total of 32 pieces per can.
Put pieces into bowl with cinnamon-sugar mixture. Roll pieces until they are fully covered in cinnamon sugar. Place pieces into the bundt pan.
Melt the sugar, brown sugar, and butter together, then bring to a boil. After glaze has thickened, pour glaze on top of biscuit pieces in the bundt pan.
Bake for 25–30 minutes. Invert onto plate and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Monkey Butter
steps: Combine all the ingredients until smooth.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Monte Cristo Burgers
steps: Preheat oven to 200°F.
Combine the egg, hot sauce, and cream in a pie plate. Dip cut sides of buns into egg mixture. Move to a cooling rack and let sit 10 minutes.
Heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Grease with cooking spray.
Add buns, one at a time, and cook until browned on cut side. Move to a clean plate and repeat until all buns have been cooked. Keep warm in the oven.
Form beef into 4 equal patties. Brush both sides with olive oil and sprinkle both sides liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.

Heat about 28 charcoal briquets in a large chimney starter. Once hot, disperse evenly around the bottom of a grill and reapply grate. Add patties and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 145°F for medium rare, 160°F for medium, and 170°F for toast.
Remove to a plate, top with cheese, and cover with aluminum foil. Let rest 3 minutes.
Place a patty on the bottom half of each bun. Top with upper half and serve warm.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Monte Cristo Sandwich
steps: Butter the first slice of bread and cover with ham and chicken.
Butter the middle slice on both sides, place on meat, and cover with cheese.
Butter the third slice and place, butter down, over cheese.
Trim crusts, then cut sandwich in two and secure with toothpicks
Dip in light egg batter, and fry in butter on all sides until golden brown.
Remove toothpicks and serve with currant jelly, strawberry jam, or cranberry sauce.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Monterey Jack Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: shredded Monterrey Jack cheese
ingredients.original: ½ cup shredded Monterrey Jack cheese

steps: Brush both sides of chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and 1 pinch of cumin.
Place in a large roasting pan and insert a probe thermometer into one of the breasts. Bake in the center of a 400°F oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and sprinkle with cheese. Place back in oven until cheese is melted.
Serve warm.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Montreal Russian Borscht

ingredients.name: stewed tomatoes, or an equivalent amount of fresh tomatoes
ingredients.original: 1 can stewed tomatoes, or an equivalent amount of fresh tomatoes

steps: Fill large stock pot with water. Add can stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, salt, onion, garlic, and beets, and boil for 20 minutes.
Add carrots, cabbage, and potato.
Return to a boil and cook for 1.5 hours

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Montreal Steak Seasoning

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes (or 3 teaspoons cayenne pepper)
ingredients.original: 4 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes (or 3 teaspoons cayenne pepper)

steps: Combine the ingredients, then use them to season steak. Can be stored in an airtight container for a number of months.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Moqueca de Peixe (Brazilian Seafood Stew)

ingredients.name: fresh white fish, cut into two finger-wide strips/slices
ingredients.original: 1 kg fresh white fish, cut into two finger-wide strips/slices

ingredients.name: mid-sized onions, cut into circular slices
ingredients.original: 2 mid-sized onions, cut into circular slices

ingredients.name: bell peppers (one red, one green), cut into circular slices
ingredients.original: 2 bell peppers (one red, one green), cut into circular slices

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes, optionally skinned then chopped
ingredients.original: 4 ripe tomatoes, optionally skinned then chopped

ingredients.name: cilantro stems with leaves
ingredients.original: 4 cilantro stems with leaves, finely chopped

ingredients.name: Azeite de dendê (a very tasty, heavy, saffron-colored palm oil, which may not be omitted under any circumstances)
ingredients.original: 12 tablespoons Azeite de dendê (a very tasty, heavy, saffron-colored palm oil, which may not be omitted under any circumstances)

steps: Leave the fish in a marinade made out of lemon juice and fine powdered pepper for at least 1 hour.
Put the fish, onions, bell peppers, garlic, tomatoes and the cilantro in numerous layers into a pot.

Pour the azeite de dendê and the coconut milk over all, and boil everything for 20 minutes. From time to time, ladle/scoop the liquid from the pot's bottom to its top. Be careful, in order to not break the fish!
Season to taste with salt.
Serve with white rice.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Morel Mushroom Sauce

ingredients.name: gray morel mushrooms, cut into slices less than 1 inch long
ingredients.original: 3 cups gray morel mushrooms, cut into slices less than 1 inch long

ingredients.name: green onion tops
ingredients.original: ¼ cup thinly-sliced green onion tops

steps: In a 12-inch non-stick skillet, heat the butter over medium-high heat until foaming.
Add the morels and sauté, stirring occasionally, for 15–20 minutes until slightly crispy.
Add the onion tops, parsley, nutmeg, pepper, and salt and cook for a few minutes
Turn up the heat, add wine, and reduce to almost a glaze
Turn heat to medium and add the cream and mustard. Reduce slightly over slow boil until thickened—about 10–12 minutes.
Serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Moroccan Couscous
steps: Combine liquids in a bowl. Set aside.
Heat a large pot over medium high heat. Pour some oil into the pot and add couscous. Sauté until couscous is slightly browned.
Add liquid mixture and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, cover, remove from the heat, and set aside, 5 minutes or until couscous is tender and all liquid has been absorbed.
Open pot and fluff couscous thoroughly with a fork or chopsticks. Serve immediately with lamb.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Moroccan Salad

ingredients.name: handful of fresh coriander
ingredients.original: 1 handful of fresh coriander, finely chopped

steps: Cut the tomatoes, pepper and onion into small dice.
Add the fresh coriander, cumin, salt, pepper, and vinegar.
Put it all into a container, put the lid on tightly, and give it a good shake to combine everything.
Let rest for 30 minutes to allow the flavours to mingle before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Moroccan Soup

ingredients.name: lamb meat or 4 chicken breasts
ingredients.original: 350 g lamb meat or 4 chicken breasts, chopped

ingredients.name: tomatoes (with garlic if possible)
ingredients.original: 400 g diced tomatoes (with garlic if possible)

ingredients.name: dried apricots divided into 8 portions
ingredients.original: 200 g dried apricots divided into 8 portions

steps: Fry the onion lightly in oil.
Add spices and the rest of the ingredients, and cook until ready. The cooking time depends on the meat used and on whether carrots and sweet potatoes are added.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Moussaka (Bulgarian)

ingredients.name: meat (usually pork in Bulgaria, but don't hesitate to experiment!)
ingredients.original: ½ kg minced meat (usually pork in Bulgaria, but don't hesitate to experiment!)

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and finely chopped
ingredients.original: 1 kg potatoes, peeled and finely chopped

steps: Fry the onion and the minced meat in a little oil until the meat is cooked. The fattier the meat is, the less oil you need.
Combine meat and onions with the potatoes, tomatoes, and parsley. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a baking dish. Bake for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes are cooked.
Stir the eggs, the yogurt and the flour together and pour it over the dish. Bake for 10 more minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mozzarella Sticks
steps: Preheat deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Slice mozzarella into sticks 1–3 cm in diameter.
In a small bowl, whisk egg.
Fill another small bowl with bread crumbs.
Dip 3–4 sticks at a time into the egg.
Shake excess egg off sticks and place them in the bread crumbs.
Shake bowl of bread crumbs, evenly coating all sticks. Add more bread crumbs as needed.
Place coated sticks to the side and repeat for remaining sticks.
After all sticks have been coated, repeat the egg-dip and crumb-coat for each once more.
Place all sticks in fryer basket and submerge in 350°F oil.
Let sit for 30 seconds, gently rocking basket occasionally.

Lift basket and let cool for a few seconds. If cheese is not beginning to ooze out from half the sticks, re-submerge in oil for another 10–15 seconds, gently shaking the basket. Repeat until the cheese is just starting to ooze out.
Dump onto paper towel and pat off excess oil gently.
Serve hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mozzarella Tuna Melts

ingredients.name: water-packed tuna, drained and flaked
ingredients.original: 1 can (6 ounces) water-packed tuna, drained and flaked

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a small bowl, combine tuna, celery, onion and mayonnaise.
Spread on bottom of buns.
Top tuna mixture with a slice of cheese and tomato.
Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 12–15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.
Top each with a lettuce leaf; replace bun tops.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: MPT (Mozzarella Pasta with Tomato and Basil)

ingredients.name: tomatoes or 4–5 larger tomatoes (you need about the same amount as the mozzarella)
ingredients.original: About 10–15 small tomatoes or 4–5 larger tomatoes (you need about the same amount as the mozzarella)

ingredients.name: A good handful of basil leaves (about 15–20 leaves)
ingredients.original: A good handful of basil leaves (about 15–20 leaves)

steps: Roughly chop the mozzarella and the tomatoes and put them in a big salad-type bowl.
Tear up the basil and sprinkle it over the mozzarella and tomatoes.
Drizzle on lots of extra virgin olive oil (at least 3 tablespoons).
Add a good amount of salt and just a little black pepper. The salt will start to leach moisture out from the other ingredients and create a sauce.
Let rest for at least 30 minutes.
Boil the egg pasta until al dente, then drain.
Add the hot pasta to the bowl of other ingredients. Toss well until the pasta is well-coated. Serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Muboora (Zimbabwean Pumpkin Leaves Stew)
steps: Wash the pumpkin leaves thoroughly and remove any tough stems or veins. Chop the leaves into small pieces and set them aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in the large pot over medium heat. Add the onions and garlic. Sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and curry powder to the pot. Cook until the tomatoes break down and form a thick sauce, stirring occasionally.

Reduce the heat to low. Gradually spoon in the peanut butter, stirring continuously. Continue stirring until the peanut butter is well blended with the tomato sauce. This should create a creamy, thick mixture.

Start adding the chopped pumpkin leaves to the pot in batches. Stir and allow each batch to wilt and mix with the sauce before adding more. Continue this process until all the pumpkin leaves are in the pot.
Pour in enough water to cover the mixture, making it into a stew-like consistency. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir everything together, ensuring the leaves are submerged.

Cover the pot and let the muboora simmer on low heat for about 20–30 minutes. Stir occasionally and check for desired tenderness of the pumpkin leaves. Add more water if necessary to maintain the desired consistency.
Once the pumpkin leaves are tender and the flavors are well blended, your muboora is ready to be served.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Mực Nhồi Thịt (Vietnamese Stuffed Squid)

ingredients.name: squid, cleaned, with tentacles removed and reserved
ingredients.original: 12 small squid, cleaned, with tentacles removed and reserved

ingredients.name: dried black mushrooms, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes and quartered
ingredients.original: 2 dried black mushrooms, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes and quartered

ingredients.name: bamboo shoots
ingredients.original: 30 grams bamboo shoots, drained and sliced

ingredients.name: dried black mushrooms, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes, stems removed, and finely chopped
ingredients.original: 2 dried black mushrooms, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes, stems removed, and finely chopped

steps: Stuffing: Combine chopped squid tentacles, minced pork fat, and garlic.
Add spring onion and mushrooms to the squid mixture, along with nước mắm, sugar, salt and pepper.
Stuff into the squid heads and secure the openings with toothpicks.

Main dish: Place stuffed squid in a casserole dish or clay pot along with the sliced carrot, bamboo shoots, spring onions, quartered mushrooms and soaking liquid, caramel sauce, chicken stock, and nước mắm.
Place in a preheated 350 °F oven, and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve in the pot accompanied by steamed rice.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Muceere (Ugandan Pumpkin Stew)

ingredients.name: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.original: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped (for garnish)

steps: In a pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic to the hot oil. Sauté until the onions become translucent and aromatic.
