source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Nigerian Yam and Potato Porridge

ingredients.name: ponmo (cow skin), properly cleaned and cut into small pieces
ingredients.original: 6 pieces of ponmo (cow skin), properly cleaned and cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: yam, peeled and sliced into 4 pieces of 10 cm diameter and 2–2.5-inch thickness
ingredients.original: 1 medium-sized yam, peeled and sliced into 4 pieces of 10 cm diameter and 2–2.5-inch thickness

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced 2–2.5-inch thick
ingredients.original: 5 medium-sized sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced 2–2.5-inch thick

steps: Peppered ponmo: Place the ponmo in a pot with water, 2 seasoning cubes, garlic, and salt to taste. Boil until the ponmo becomes soft, which should take about 10 minutes.
Blend the chile peppers until about 70% smooth.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Pour 1 cooking spoon of palm oil and ½ spoon of vegetable oil into the pan, and heat them for about 2 minutes.
Add one-third of the finely chopped onions to the pan and fry them, stirring continuously for approximately 2 minutes.
Add the blended peppers, curry powder, ½ teaspoon of salt, and pepper. Let the mixture fry for about 8 minutes.
Add the cooked ponmo to the pan and stir to combine. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for approximately 5 minutes.
Keep warm until time to serve.
Porridge: In a large pot, combine 1 cup of water and 1 teaspoon of salt. Add the yam, sweet potato, and sliced onions.
Boil the yam and sweet potatoes until they are about 60% softened (approximately halfway done). This process usually takes around 12 minutes. Do not drain.
Blend the ginger-garlic paste, remaining seasoning cubes, and tomato paste together until smooth.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Add 2 spoons of palm oil and 1½ spoons of vegetable oil to the pan, and heat them for about 2 minutes
Add half the remaining finely chopped onions to the pan and fry them, stirring continuously for approximately 2 minutes.
Add the tomato mixture and salt to taste. Stir continuously until the mixture fries and has lost some liquid.
Stir the fried tomato mixture into the pot with the yam and potatoes. Add the crayfish and remaining chopped onions. Stir well and cover the pot, allowing it to cook for 5 minutes.
Using a wooden stirring rod, stir and mash the yam and potato, leaving some chunks for texture.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir the porridge and remove it from the heat, allowing it to steam. Serve the hot porridge on a plate with the peppered ponmo.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Nigiri Sushi
steps: If making nigirizushi that requires a band of nori to hold the sushi together, cut the nori into strips about ¼ inch wide and long enough to wrap around the finished sushi with at least 1 inch (2.5 cm) of overlap. Place one such strip on the preparing surface.

Hand form the sushi rice into suitable sized sushi bases. Generally, this means a rectangular block about ½–1 inch wide, 1–1½ inch (2.5–4 cm) long, and ½–¾ inch (1.5–2 cm) high. It takes considerable experience to form pleasing sushi bases by hand (beginners may find a plastic sushi mold helpful for forming the bases). Wetting the hands in water prior to forming each sushi base keeps the rice from sticking to the hands.
For nigirizushi requiring wasabi between the rice and topping, add a small dab of wasabi on the rice.
Add the selected topping on top of the sushi rice.

If nori is used, wrap one of the nori band ends up and over the nigirisushi topping firmly, so that it sticks to the rice and topping. Wet the other nori band end with a small amount of water, and wrap it up and over the topping so that it overlaps the other nori end. The water causes the nori ends to stick together.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Nilagang Baka (Boiled Beef and Vegetables in Broth)
steps: Boil beef, peppercorns, onion, salt, corn, and potato until tender.
Slice onion chives into 3-inch strips. Add to the boiling beef.
Slice saba into half. Add to the boiling beef.
Serve in one large bowl or individual serving bowls.
Serve with rice on the side.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Nkhwani wa Ndiwo (Malawian Vegetable Fritters)

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables (e.g. carrots, cabbage, onions, and green beans)
ingredients.original: 2 cups grated mixed vegetables (e.g. carrots, cabbage, onions, and green beans)

ingredients.name: green chile (optional, for heat)
ingredients.original: 1 green chile (optional, for heat), finely chopped

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the grated mixed vegetables, all-purpose flour, beaten egg, baking powder, and finely chopped green chili (if using).
Add the cornmeal to the mixture and mix well until everything is evenly combined.
Season the mixture with salt to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
In a frying pan, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Take spoonfuls of the vegetable mixture and carefully drop them into the hot oil. Flatten the fritters slightly with the back of the spoon.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy on both sides. Use a slotted spoon to remove them from the oil and place them on paper towels to drain any excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining vegetable mixture.
Allow the fritters to cool slightly before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Nkwobi (Nigerian Spicy Cow Foot)
steps: Cut the cow feet into small pieces, and remove all the bigger bones.
Place the cow feet in a pot, along with the salt, seasoning cubes, and chopped onions.
Add just enough water to cover the meat. Simmer until the meat is tender. Add small amounts of water as necessary, but there should be little to no liquid left in the pot once the meat is done.
In a separate pot, boil the ugba separately for just 3 minutes. Drain.
Dissolve the potash in a cup of water, and strain it into a separate pot. Add the palm oil to the potash water, and stir well until thick and yellow.
Add the crayfish, boiled ugba, Cameroon pepper, seasoning cube, and salt to the palm oil mixture. Stir well.
Add your cooked meat, and stir to coat with the palm oil mixture.
Serve in a wooden bowl with toppings of round-cut onions and sliced utazi leaves.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Nni Ede (Nigerian Pounded Cocoyam)
steps: Cut the cocoyam into small pieces. Rinse the pieces, and boil them for few minutes. Drain the cocoyam.
Mix water into the cassava flour to make a dough. Shape into balls.
Boil the cassava balls for few minutes, then drain.
Pound together the cassava balls and cocoyam until smooth and lump-free.
Serve with your choice of soup.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cheesecake

ingredients.name: tennis biscuits or digestive biscuits, crushed to fine crumbs
ingredients.original: 200 g (7 oz) tennis biscuits or digestive biscuits, crushed to fine crumbs

ingredients.name: cream cheese, softened to room temperature
ingredients.original: 540 g (19 oz) cream cheese, softened to room temperature

ingredients.name: tinned sweetened condensed milk
ingredients.original: 750 g (26.4 oz) tinned sweetened condensed milk

steps: Combine melted butter with biscuit crumbs. Press into a pie dish to make a crust.
Beat cream cheese until smooth and fluffy.
Beat lemon juice and condensed milk together.
Mix the condensed milk mixture into beaten cream cheese until thoroughly combined.
Pour filling into the prepared pie dish.
Refrigerate for minimum of 24 hours until set.

source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: packs graham crackers, plain digestive biscuits, or whole wheat biscuits; crumbled
ingredients.original: 2½ packs graham crackers, plain digestive biscuits, or whole wheat biscuits; crumbled

steps: Melt the margarine.
Mix the sugar and the egg.
Add the melted butter to the egg/sugar mixture.
Add the cocoa and the vanilla extract.
Add crumbled graham crackers. Mix well until all crackers are covered.
Line a cake pan with aluminum foil and pour in mixture.
Leave in refrigerator for 1 hour (preferably longer).
Unmold and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie

ingredients.name: chocolate chip cookies (recipe uses 26 cookies)
ingredients.original: 1 package (15–18 oz/450 g) chocolate chip cookies (recipe uses 26 cookies)

ingredients.name: ea. (9 oz/270 g) commercial graham cracker pie crust ("extra serving" or "deep dish" size)
ingredients.original: 1 ea. (9 oz/270 g) commercial graham cracker pie crust ("extra serving" or "deep dish" size)

ingredients.name: container (8 oz/240 g) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
ingredients.original: 1 container (8 oz/240 g) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: Dip 8 cookies in milk, then place in a single layer in graham cracker crust. Top with one-third of the whipped topping.
Repeat the above step so that you have a total of 3 layers of cookies and whipped topping.
Crumble 2 chocolate chip cookies, and sprinkle over pie.
Cover and chill for 8 hours before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies

ingredients.name: smooth or chunky peanut butter
ingredients.original: ½ cup smooth or chunky peanut butter

steps: Combine the sugar and cocoa in a saucepan, and stir well.
Add milk and stir well. Add butter and place over medium-high heat.
Bring mixture to a boil. When it reaches a rolling boil that cannot be stirred down, boil while stirring for exactly 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until peanut butter is melted and mixture is smooth.
Add oatmeal and stir to combine. Immediately spoon the mixture onto a cookie sheet, leaving enough space between them for spreading out.
Let stand on counter for at least 20 minutes to stiffen or refrigerate to speed up the process.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Pie

ingredients.name: packs of 'marie' biscuits (also known as 'rich tea' biscuits)
ingredients.original: 2–3 packs of 'marie' biscuits (also known as 'rich tea' biscuits)

ingredients.name: Cold brewed black coffee or other taste makers
ingredients.original: Cold brewed black coffee or other taste makers (optional)

steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan, then mix in the sugar.
Stir in the cocoa and milk.

Dip biscuits in the coffee, and arrange them in the bottom of the dish to make a single layer. Spread the chocolate mixture on top of the biscuits. Repeat this step until you run out of biscuits and chocolate.
Scatter the sprinkles on top, then chill in the fridge until set.
Slice and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: No-Bake Matsa Cake

ingredients.name: raisins, soaked in 1 tablespoon sweet red wine
ingredients.original: 2 ounces raisins, soaked in 1 tablespoon sweet red wine

ingredients.name: butter, melted and cooled slightly
ingredients.original: ½ lb butter, melted and cooled slightly

steps: Combine brown sugar, cocoa, soaked raisins, and melted butter.
Add this mixture to the crumbled matzah and mix well.
Divide the mixture into two 9-inch springform or other cake pans.
Knead the batter to create a flat and smooth surface.
Refrigerate for several hours.

recipes.title: Nonpareil Sauce (Hartshorne)

ingredients.name: breast of roasted fowl, chopped fine
ingredients.original: 1 breast of roasted fowl, chopped fine

steps: Combine all the ingredients together.
Boil this mixture until warm and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
