source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sese Plaintains (Cameroonian Plantain Stew)

ingredients.name: chicken-flavour bouillon cube or powder
ingredients.original: 2 tablespoons chicken-flavour bouillon cube or powder

ingredients.name: fresh kale leaves
ingredients.original: 1 bunch of fresh kale leaves, chopped

steps: Cut the ends off the plantains. Make a shallow slit through the length of the peel, and remove it.
Slice the plantains into thick rounds.
Boil the meat in a saucepan with salt, cayenne pepper, half the onions, and bouillon cubes until tender.
Add the plantain, crayfish, red oil, and remaining onions. Simmer for about 15–20 minutes.
Stir in the kale, and cook for an additional 8 minutes.
Remove from the heat and serve warm.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sev Puri (Crispy Indian Snack with Potato)

ingredients.name: red chile pepper (lal mirchi)
ingredients.original: ½ tsp red chile pepper (lal mirchi)

steps: Arrange the puris on a plate, and make a hole in the center of each puri.
Fill with a few chopped boiled potato cubes.
Add about ¼ tsp of tamarind and green chutneys in each. Sprinkle with cumin powder, salt, red chilli powder.
Sprinkle finely chopped onions over top, then generously sprinkle sev all over the puris.
Garnish with finely chopped coriander.
Serve fresh.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Seven Minute Icing
steps: Put the egg white, sugar, and water in the top of a double boiler.
Place over boiling water and beat with a rotary egg beater seven minutes.
Then add baking powder and flavoring.
Remove from heat and beat until thick.
Spread in swirls over cake.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Seviyan Ji Khirni (Sindhi Vermicelli Pudding)

ingredients.name: South Asian vermicelli (short, fine wheat noodles)
ingredients.original: 3 tbsp South Asian vermicelli (short, fine wheat noodles)

steps: Heat ghee in a skillet. Add vermicelli, and fry over low heat until golden brown. Remove from the heat.
Bring the milk to a boil. Add vermicelli, cardamom, and saffron. Simmer until the vermicelli are tender and the milk is reduced to a little more than half the original volume.
Mix in the sugar, and boil for 5–7 minutes.
Serve, garnished with almonds.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shakshuka bil Lahm (Libyan Meat Shakshuka)

ingredients.name: beef or lamb, cut into small cubes
ingredients.original: 500 grams (1 lb) beef or lamb, cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: ground cayenne pepper (optional, for extra heat)
ingredients.original: ½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (optional, for extra heat)

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.original: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Add the cubed meat to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the diced bell peppers and tomatoes to the skillet. Stir well to combine.
Sprinkle the cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and pepper over the ingredients in the skillet. Stir to evenly distribute the spices.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet with a lid, and let the mixture simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the flavors have melded together.
Using a spoon, create small wells in the sauce and carefully crack the eggs into each well.
Cover the skillet again and let the shakshuka cook for an additional 5–7 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley or cilantro.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shakshuka I
steps: On a high heat, heat the oil for about ½ minute. Add the paprika and blend well.
Add the garlic and peppers, and turn to low flame. Cook for about 10 minutes, until the peppers have slightly softened.
Add the tomatoes and bring to a boil, then season to taste with salt and pepper.
Make 6 dents in the mixture. Into each dent, put an egg yolk, and spread the egg whites around.
Continue to cook on low until the egg whites have coagulated.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shakshuka II

ingredients.name: Cayenne pepper, paprika, and turmeric
ingredients.original: Cayenne pepper, paprika, and turmeric to taste

steps: Peel and chop the onion. Fry it in the oil until it turns translucent.
Chop the tomatoes and pepper, and add to the onion in the pan.
Add herbs and spices. Cover and let cook until the tomatoes are evenly cooked through (around 25 minutes on low heat).
With a wooden spoon, make two holes in the onion-tomato mix.
Break and pour each egg into its own hole. Cover and let cook until the eggs are firm (around 5 more minutes).
Serve with bread.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sharba Libya (Libyan Soup)

ingredients.name: lamb or beef, cut into small cubes
ingredients.original: 500 grams (1 lb) lamb or beef, cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: macaroni or other small pasta
ingredients.original: 1 cup macaroni or other small pasta

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.original: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the diced lamb or beef cubes to the pot and cook until browned on all sides. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Once the meat is browned, add the diced carrots, potatoes, celery, green and red bell peppers, zucchini, green peas, and chickpeas to the pot. Stir well to combine with the meat.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, turmeric, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, coriander, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to coat the ingredients with the spices and tomato paste.

Pour enough water into the pot to cover all the ingredients. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 1 hour. This allows the flavors to meld together and the meat to become tender.
In the meantime, cook the macaroni or small pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
After the soup has simmered for an hour, taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Add the cooked macaroni or small pasta to the soup and stir to incorporate. Let the soup simmer for another 10 minutes to allow the pasta to absorb the flavors.
Remove the pot from the heat. Ladle into serving bowls and garnish with fresh chopped parsley or cilantro.
Serve the soup hot with crusty bread on the side.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sharbat bil Loz

ingredients.name: sugar (optional, it is healthier without sugar)
ingredients.original: 3 cups sugar (optional, it is healthier without sugar)

ingredients.name: orange blossom water (or rosewater)
ingredients.original: ¼ cup orange blossom water (or rosewater)

steps: Grind the almonds finely in blender.
Add the water and continue to grind.
Strain the liquid through a sieve lined with cheesecloth, reserving the liquid.
When drained, squeeze the remaining pulp to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard the pulp.
Pour into a heavy saucepan, then stir in the sugar (optional).
Boil, stirring constantly, then lower the heat and simmer very gently for 5–10 minutes.
Turn off the heat, add the orange flower water, and let the syrup cool.
To serve, pour ¼ cup of syrup into a glass, add ice water, and stir well.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shark Fin Soup
steps: Clean the fins and place in lukewarm water.
Soak ground shrimp and dried mushrooms for 30 minutes in ¼ litre warm water. The water can then be discarded. The dried bamboo should also be soaked until soft, then cut into thin strips.
Thoroughly clean and scale the shark fins, then place in a litre of water. Simmer for 1 hour. Afterwards, set the water aside.
Place fins in a fresh litre of water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1½ hours. Afterwards, strain fins.
In a separate pot, add chicken broth and bring to a boil. Add ginger and shrimp and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove from heat and strain the broth, discarding the shrimp and ginger.
In a separate pot, heat the bacon fat, adding the bamboo shoots and mushrooms together with salt.
Sauté for 1 minute, then add soy sauce, wine, broth, fish stock, and fins. Boil over low heat, stirring frequently, for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and slowly stir in the corn starch, in small increments. Sprinkle sesame oil on the soup.
Serve in a large bowl. The shark fins should remain on the surface.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sharmoula bil Lahm (Libyan Marinated Meat Sharmoula)

ingredients.name: ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)
ingredients.original: ½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)

ingredients.name: boneless beef or lamb cubes
ingredients.original: 1 kg (2.2 lbs) boneless beef or lamb cubes

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.original: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the minced garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, ground cumin, paprika, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to form a smooth marinade.
Add the beef or lamb cubes to the marinade and toss them until they are evenly coated. Ensure that each piece of meat is well covered with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2–4 hours to allow the flavors to meld and the meat to absorb the marinade.
Preheat the grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, leaving a small gap between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill or grill pan and cook for approximately 10–15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While grilling, brush any remaining marinade onto the meat for added flavor and moisture.
Once cooked, remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley or cilantro before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shashlik (Russian Skewered Meat)

ingredients.name: Pieces of onion, red or green bell pepper, bacon, sausage, cucumber, baby mushrooms
ingredients.original: Pieces of onion, red or green bell pepper, bacon, sausage, cucumber, baby mushrooms

steps: Mix the honey, mustard, vodka, salt and pepper in a deep bowl and soak the meat pieces in it. Leave the bowl in the refrigerator for 3 hours.
Arrange the meat pieces on wooden or metal skewers, putting some pieces of bacon, sausage, pepper, onion, mushrooms, cucumber, according to your preference, between the pieces of meat.
Grill the skewers.
Serve with potato and other salads! Enjoy!

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sheer Khurma

ingredients.name: dried dates, soaked overnight, pitted and chopped thin
ingredients.original: 100 g dried dates, soaked overnight, pitted and chopped thin

steps: Heat the ghee in a large pot over a low heat.
Add the cashew nuts to the ghee, and fry until browned.
Turn off the flame and add the raisins. When the raisins swell up, take both them and the cashews out of the ghee with a spoon and set aside.
Switch the low heat back on and heat the ghee. Add the vermicelli and fry, stirring so it turns golden-brown. Watch it carefully so it does not burn.
Pour in the milk and water. Add the cashews and raisins back into the mixture.
Add the sliced dates and almonds. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until the vermicelli starts to get flexible; then add sugar.
Keep on the low flame for another 2 minutes, then add cream and cardamom powder.
Heat just a little longer and mix well.
Serve hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie I

ingredients.name: or ground lamb or beef
ingredients.original: 1 lb (450 g) minced or ground lamb or beef

ingredients.name: powdery old potatoes, such as King Edwards
ingredients.original: 3 lb (1.3 kg) powdery old potatoes, such as King Edwards

ingredients.name: beef stock (alternatively, bouillon cubes can be used, or gravy powder, if the flour is omitted)
ingredients.original: 2 cups (300 ml) beef stock (alternatively, bouillon cubes can be used, or gravy powder, if the flour is omitted)

ingredients.name: handful of mixed vegetables such as sweetcorn or carrots
ingredients.original: 1 handful of mixed vegetables such as sweetcorn or carrots (optional)

steps: Heat oil in a pan and brown the mince. Where lean meat is used, there may be no need to use additional oil.
Finely chop the onion and lightly fry in a little butter with a small amount of salt until clear.
Add the onions to the mince, mixed herbs, and some pepper.
Sprinkle the flour over the mixture, stir, and cook for 3–4 minutes (if using gravy powder, omit this step).
Cover with lamb or beef stock (or add water and beef bouillon/gravy powder) and simmer for 30 minutes.
Test the savoury mince for seasoning. If gravy is not used, additional salt may be needed.
Meanwhile:
Peel, chop and boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until cooked.
Once the meat is cooked, skim off the excess fat, then reduce the savoury mince until the liquid is level with the mince and onions.
Drain the potatoes until completely dry. Mash until smooth and free of any lumps.
Add butter to the mashed potato, taste and add seasoning as required.
Slowly add milk whilst mashing until the mash is soft and creamy (heavy mash will not float properly on top of the mince).
Put mince mixture in a shallow oven-proof dish.
Layer the mash over the meat and brush the tops of the potatoes with melted butter.
If desired, sprinkle the grated cheese on top of the mash.
If cooking without cheese, rough up the surface of the mash by dragging a fork across it, as if ploughing a field.
Bake in a hot oven for about 30–50 minutes until the top is golden brown.
Serve with peas or beans, or other green vegetables.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie II

ingredients.name: lean ground hamburger meat
ingredients.original: 1 pound (450 g) lean ground hamburger meat

ingredients.name: creamed corn
ingredients.original: 12 oz (341 ml or 1 can) creamed corn

ingredients.name: Salt, pepper, and butter
ingredients.original: Salt, pepper, and butter to taste

ingredients.name: shredded Cheddar or Mexican blend cheese (optional, amount depends on how much cheese you want)
ingredients.original: 1–2 cups shredded Cheddar or Mexican blend cheese (optional, amount depends on how much cheese you want)

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C)
In a large skillet, brown the hamburger meat until it is no longer pink
In a medium baking pan, evenly layer the meat on the bottom, then corn. Spread a layer of potatoes.
If using, sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie III

ingredients.name: olive oil or other cooking oil
ingredients.original: 5 ml olive oil or other cooking oil

steps: Peel and chop the potatoes. Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes whilst preparing the rest of the meal.
Cut the minced lamb and add the garlic.
Next gently heat some olive oil in a frying pan and add the meat and garlic
Then add the vegetables, ketchup, stock cube (or gravy) and cook on a very low heat for 5 minutes.
Add flour and water and mix well.
Cook the mixture for about 25 minutes and stir every few minutes.
Once the potatoes are ready drain them, add a touch of milk and butter (or margarine) and mash.
Pour the mixture into an oven dish then add the mashed potatoes on top. Cover all of the lamb mixture.
Bake in the oven at 200°C for about 15–20 minutes and take it out when the potatoes are turning golden.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shikanjvi (Punjabi Spiced Lemonade)
steps: Pour the water into a glass.
Add the lemon juice, ginger, sugar, salt and pepper, then shake it vigorously.
Serve cold.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shirmal (Persian Saffron Flatbread)
steps: Soak the saffron strands in the warm milk. Set aside.
Sift together flour and salt, then sprinkle in sugar.
Add the melted ghee, and mix with your fingers until evenly distributed.
Add milk a little at a time, and knead the mixture to a dough. When it forms a soft smooth lump, cover with a moist cloth and set aside for 2 hours.
Knead, then set aside again for 2 hours.
Knead again, and divide the dough into 7 parts.
Rub saffron strands in the milk to dissolve them.
Place an inverted heavy iron pan on the lower shelf of oven. Keep the grill on upper rack. Preheat to 250°C (480°F).
On a floured surface, roll each piece of dough into a thick round about 6 inches in diameter. Prick with fork all over.
Slap dough onto the hot pan base, and allow to bake until brown spots appear.
Move sheermal to the grill with tongs. Dip fingers in saffron milk and splash on sheermal. Keep in oven few more seconds.
Remove sheermal, and either immediately serve hot or wrap in slightly moist towel.
Apply butter or ghee on top if desired. Serve with gravies, veggies, curds, pickles or jams.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shiro (Ethiopian Spiced Chickpea or Lentil Stew)

ingredients.name: shiro powder (chickpea or lentil flour)
ingredients.original: 1 cup shiro powder (chickpea or lentil flour)

ingredients.name: salt, or
ingredients.original: ½ teaspoon salt, or to taste

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.original: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and sauté until translucent and slightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and sauté for an additional minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle the berbere spice blend, ground cumin, ground turmeric, salt, and black pepper over the onions and garlic. Stir well to coat the ingredients with the spices.
Add the shiro powder to the pot and stir it into the onion and spice mixture.
Gradually pour in the vegetable broth or water while continuously stirring to prevent any lumps from forming.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for about 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally. The stew will thicken and develop a rich flavor.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the shiro rest for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish the shiro with fresh chopped parsley or cilantro. Serve hot with injera or bread for dipping.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shiro Wat (Ethiopian Pea Stew)

ingredients.name: spoons berberei (a spice mix with red pepper powder)
ingredients.original: 4 spoons berberei (a spice mix with red pepper powder)

ingredients.name: spoons shiro powder (made from different cereals and beans, typically split green peas)
ingredients.original: 4 spoons shiro powder (made from different cereals and beans, typically split green peas)

steps: Heat a medium-size skillet, add the onion, and cook for 1–2 minutes.
Add the oil, and after 1 minute add berberei. Cook it for 4–5 minutes, stirring regularly and adding a dash of water if it tries to stick on the pan.
Add the water.
When the water boils, add the shiro, carefully stirring it in the pan; it should not make lumps. Then cook it for 5 minutes, stirring it regularly.
Finally, add salt and the butter, and after 2–3 minutes, remove it from the heat.
Served hot or cold with injera.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shirred Egg
steps: Butter a shirred egg dish (a small casserole or custard dish).
Put the dish on a low heat to melt the butter, or just add 2–3 tsp cream.
Break an egg in the dish over the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Optionally, sprinkle with shredded cheese and/or bread crumbs.
Bake in the oven at 375°F long enough to set the whites of the eggs. Alternatively, cook by placing the dish directly on low heat.
Serve in the same dish.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shitha

ingredients.name: red chile powder (or fresh red chilies, blended)
ingredients.original: 2 tablespoons red chile powder (or fresh red chilies, blended)

steps: Heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Add chile powder and salt. Stir well.
Simmer for 10–15 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Add lemon juice or vinegar if desired for extra tanginess.
Let it cool before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shopska Salata (Tomato, Cucumber, and Bell Pepper Salad)

ingredients.name: roasted peppers or fresh green bell peppers
ingredients.original: 2 roasted peppers or fresh green bell peppers

ingredients.name: spoonfuls chopped red onion or green onion
ingredients.original: 2 spoonfuls chopped red onion or green onion

ingredients.name: white cheese (feta; optional)
ingredients.original: ½ pound (225 g) white cheese (feta; optional)

steps: Cut the tomatoes, cucumbers and peppers in small pieces—cubes if possible.
Mix well with the parsley, onion, salt, and oil.
Serve with white cheese grated on top. Enjoy!

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shorba bil Lahm (Libyan Meat Soup)

ingredients.name: boneless lamb or beef, cut into small cubes
ingredients.original: 500 grams (1 lb) boneless lamb or beef, cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)
ingredients.original: ½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)

ingredients.name: vegetable broth or beef broth
ingredients.original: 1 liter (4 cups) vegetable broth or beef broth

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.original: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the diced lamb or beef cubes to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in the ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper, and cook for another minute to toast the spices.
Add the chopped carrots, potatoes, and tomatoes to the pot, and stir well to combine with the meat and spices.
Pour in the vegetable broth or beef broth, and bring the soup to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let the soup simmer for about 1 hour, or until the meat is tender and the flavors have melded together.
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shortbread

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.original: 380 g (1 ½ cup / 13 ½ oz) all-purpose flour

ingredients.name: white granulated sugar
ingredients.original: 110 g (½ cup / 4 oz) white granulated sugar

steps: Preheat the oven to 140°C (275°F or Gas Mark 1).
Cream the butter with the sugar until light and fluffy.
Sift the flour and salt into the mixture and work into the fat and sugar until completely amalgamated.
Shape the dough into a ball and roll out to about 1.3 cm (½ inch) thick. The dough may need to be chilled for 10–15 minutes for easier handling.
Cut into squares or rectangles and prick the tops with a fork in two parallel lines.
Bake in the oven for 30–40 minutes or until the shortbread is lightly browned.
Leave them on a cooling rack to cool.
Store in a cool place in an airtight container.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shortcrust Pastry

ingredients.name: plain flour, plus extra for dusting
ingredients.original: 120 g (1 cup) plain flour, plus extra for dusting

steps: Cream together butter, sugar, and lemon rind in a bowl.
Sift together the plain and potato flours into a mound.
Make a well in the center of the mound and add the creamed mixture.
Knead lightly until the dough is consistent.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour before use.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shrewsbury Cakes
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Place butter in mixing bowl along with sugar. Cream until the mixture is fluffy.
Break the egg into the mixture, and stir it in completely.
Add the nutmeg and flour to the mixture, and stir in completely.
Spray or butter the cookie sheets.
Place teaspoons of the batter onto the cookie sheets about two inches apart.
Place in the oven and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.
Take the cakes out of the oven, if the cakes have stuck together, use a knife to cut them apart.
Use spatula to place the cakes onto a plate.
Enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Cheese Grits

ingredients.name: sweet onion, cut into thin strips
ingredients.original: ½ large sweet onion, cut into thin strips

ingredients.name: yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
ingredients.original: ½ yellow bell pepper, cut into strips

ingredients.name: red bell pepper, cut into strips
ingredients.original: ½ red bell pepper, cut into strips

ingredients.name: hot sauce, or to taste
ingredients.original: ¼–½ teaspoon hot sauce, or to taste (optional)

steps: Fry bacon until crisp, remove and set aside.
Sauté onions, garlic, and peppers in bacon grease, add lime juice and hot sauce and set aside.
Prepare grits per the directions on box. Add cheese and butter when done cooking to allow for them to melt, then set aside.
Stir when done melting.
Sauté the shrimp until they turn pink, about 2–3 minutes.
Place the grits and cheese in large serving container and place the shrimp down the center of the container.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shrimp Curry

ingredients.name: peeled, deveined jumbo shrimp, heads removed
ingredients.original: 1 pound peeled, deveined jumbo shrimp, heads removed

steps: Heat oil in a large stainless steel sauté pan over medium high heat. Add shrimp and sauté just until bright pink. Remove and keep warm.
Melt ghee in same pan. Add vegetables and sauté until browned around edges.
Add remaining ingredients and shrimp and toss to coat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook until shrimp are heated through.
Remove and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fritters (Accra)

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.original: ¼ cup (60 ml) green pepper, chopped

ingredients.name: Scotch bonnet or other hot pepper
ingredients.original: 1 Scotch bonnet or other hot pepper, minced

steps: Combine green pepper, spring onions, onions, and scotch bonnet in a bowl.
Add remaining ingredients except water, and mix thoroughly.
Stir in enough water to make a soft mixture using a spoon. Beat mixture until is smooth.
Using a pan or deep fryer, drop spoonfuls in to hot oil, and fry until all sides are brown.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shrimp Hooman (Goan Shrimp Curry)

ingredients.name: coconut, preferably fresh
ingredients.original: 1 cup (240 ml) grated coconut, preferably fresh

ingredients.name: tamarind (the size of a small marble)
ingredients.original: 1 piece of tamarind (the size of a small marble)

ingredients.name: drumstick (frozen works fine), cut into 8–10 pieces
ingredients.original: 1 drumstick (frozen works fine), cut into 8–10 pieces

steps: Put the shrimp, onion, drumsticks, and asafoetida in a saucepan. Add a little water and cook until the shrimp and drumsticks are done. If using white fish instead of shrimp, then omit the shrimp at this stage.

Grind the grated coconut, chile peppers, turmeric, pepper and tamarind to a fine paste. If needed, add a tiny amount of water to form a thick fine paste. Avoid watering down the paste as far as possible.
Add to the shrimp mix and bring to a boil. If using white fish, add at this point.
Add salt to taste.
Serve with hot white rice.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi Angel Hair Pasta with Lemon and Pine Nuts

ingredients.name: shrimp scampi, garlic and butter flavor
ingredients.original: 1 package (12 ounces) shrimp scampi, garlic and butter flavor

ingredients.name: fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves
ingredients.original: ½ cup fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, roughly chopped

ingredients.name: zest and juice of 1 lemon
ingredients.original: Finely grated zest and juice of 1 lemon

ingredients.name: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.original: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Boil large pot of cold water and salt it generously.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring occasionally until al dente, 4–5 minutes.
Drain the pasta reserving about 1 cup of the cooking water.
Prepare the shrimp in a large skillet according to package directions.
Stir the lemon zest and juice into the shrimp.
Add the pasta, reserved pasta water, parsley and pine nuts, and toss in the skillet to coat the pasta evenly.
Divide shrimp and pasta among warm pasta bowls and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Silog

ingredients.name: fried chicken egg (sunny side-up or beaten)
ingredients.original: 1 fried chicken egg (sunny side-up or beaten)

steps: Place the fried rice and the egg on your plate.
Arrange your desired add-ons around the rice.
Serve with any desired condiments, such as spicy vinegar.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Silvash Gombotz (Hungarian Plum Dumplings)

ingredients.name: Fresh plums, plum jam or plum compote
ingredients.original: Fresh plums, plum jam or plum compote

steps: Cook potatoes until very soft (at least an hour). Peel and mash with a fork.
Add the egg to the mixture, along with the little salt and oil. Mix well.
Gradually mix in the flour to make a smooth dough. You may need a little more or less than the listed quantity.
Knead the potato dough, then roll it out into a thin sheet (about 5 mm thick), and cut into squares.
Put half a plum or 1 tsp of plum jam on each square. Wrap the dough around the filling and seal the edges.
Cook in boiling water for 10–15 minutes until the dumplings are floating and cooked through.
Serve with bread crumbs fried in butter.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simmering Tofu Stir-fry

ingredients.name: Mixture of preferred vegetables (suggested combination: onion, green pepper, tomato)
ingredients.original: Mixture of preferred vegetables (suggested combination: onion, green pepper, tomato)

ingredients.name: Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: pepper, hot sauce, salt)
ingredients.original: Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: pepper, hot sauce, salt)

steps: Slice tofu into manageable slices (no more than ¼ inch thick).
Slice all vegetables and apple.
Simmer tofu and vegetable in a light mixture of olive oil and soy sauce on medium high heat.
Cook until tofu is golden brown and vegetables have thoroughly soaked up juices.
Serve with a side of rice or couscous and season.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Ayurvedic Sprout Salad

ingredients.name: fresh mung bean sprouts (sprout your own and use them when the sprouts are about 1/2 inch long)
ingredients.original: 1 cup fresh mung bean sprouts (sprout your own and use them when the sprouts are about ½ inch long)

ingredients.name: peeled, deseeded, diced cucumber
ingredients.original: ½ cup peeled, deseeded, diced cucumber

steps: Combine the veggies and sprouts in a glass bowl.
Whisk together the salt, pepper, lemon juice, and olive oil in a separate bowl. Add to the salad and toss well to mix.
Garnish with the cilantro and sunflower seeds, and serve at room temperature or cool.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Biryani

ingredients.name: basmati rice, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes
ingredients.original: 300 g basmati rice, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes

steps: Wash the rice with cold water until it runs clear.
Cook the onion, cardamom pods, bay leaves, and cinnamon in the butter for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, turmeric, and curry paste, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and raisins and then the chicken stock.
Cover the pan tightly and bring to the boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and rest for 10 minutes, allowing the rice to absorb any remaining moisture.
Stir in half the coriander and serve with the rest sprinkled over the top.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Boiled Chickpeas
steps: Cover the chickpeas completely with water, and let them soak overnight. Drain the chickpeas.
Combine the chickpeas and celery in a pot. Add enough water to completely cover the contents by a few inches.

Bring the pot to a simmer over medium heat. Cook for about 2 hours until the chickpeas are tender—the cooking time is not an exact science, and you will need to bite into a chickpea to see if it is fully cooked.
Once the chickpeas are done, drain the cooking liquid. If desired, you can reserve it to use as aquafaba.
Use the cooked chickpeas as you would canned chickpeas. Alternatively, you can season them with salt, pepper, and a dash of olive oil and vinegar if you would like to eat them plain.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Buttercream
steps: Cream together butter and vanilla using a mixer.
Beat in powdered sugar one cup at a time, scraping sides and bottom of bowl regularly. Mixture will be very dry.
When all the sugar is incorporated, add milk and beat until incorporated.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Chicken Salad
steps: Toss together all ingredients until well-combined.
Serve cool or at room temperature.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Chocolate Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: unsweetened cocoa powder
ingredients.original: ¼ cup (60 ml) unsweetened cocoa powder

steps: Melt the cream cheese, and cool slightly. Transfer to a mixing bowl.
Mix in the cocoa powder and powdered sugar.
Fold in the whipped topping.
Pour mixture into the into ready-made crust
Cover and place in a refrigerator/freezer. Remove when solid.
Serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Chocolate Fudge
steps: Use a double boiler to melt the chocolate chips. Failing to use a double boiler will result in burned chocolate.
Add the sweetened condensed milk. Stir until mixed.
Pour into a lined baking dish, bowl, or other mold. Expect it to stick if you don't use wax paper or foil.
Let cool for several hours.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Flatbread
steps: Take 2 handfuls of flour and put in a bowl. Using a spoon, make a well in the middle.
Fill the well halfway with vegetable oil and the other half with water.
Fold in the flour and mix until a dough comes together in the bowl.
Let rest for 1 hour.
Divide dough into 4 parts. Taking 1 piece of dough, flatten it with your palms and then stretch the dough until it is thin as a tissue.
Cook on a pan or other hot surface until small to medium bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip onto other side (with your hand or spatula) to let cook for 30–40 seconds more.
Repeat cooking steps until all the dough is used up.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Italian Sausage Spaghetti Dinner

ingredients.name: mild or hot Italian sausage
ingredients.original: ½ pound mild or hot Italian sausage

ingredients.name: red or dry white wine
ingredients.original: ½ cups red or dry white wine

steps: Prepare pasta according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a 4½-quart saucepan or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Peel and finely chop onion, adding to pan as you chop.
Remove casings from sausage, if necessary, and crumble sausage into the pan. Stir and cook, breaking up the sausage, until the sausage is cooked through and the onion is tender, about 5 minutes.
Add wine to pan and stir to loosen any brown bits on the bottom of the pan.
Add canned tomatoes and their juice, tomato paste, garlic, sugar and Italian seasoning.
Stir to combine, then reduce heat to medium-low.
Stir in Parmesan cheese, and cook until pasta is ready.
Serve the sauce with the cooked pasta.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Nachos

ingredients.name: lean ground beef (92% lean or greater)
ingredients.original: 1 pound (450 g) lean ground beef (92% lean or greater)

ingredients.name: tomatoes with green chiles
ingredients.original: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles

ingredients.name: or less taco seasoning mix (mostly cumin)
ingredients.original: 2 teaspoons or less taco seasoning mix (mostly cumin)

steps: In a skillet, brown ground beef with Mexican seasoning and Taco Mix.
When beef is browned add the can of diced tomatoes with green chiles, cover and allow to simmer an additional 5 minutes.
Put tortilla chips on a large plate. Place 2 tablespoons of sour cream on plate. Sprinkle beef and diced tomato mixture over top of the chips.
Serve and enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Restaurant Miso Soup

ingredients.name: A few 1 cm cubes of medium-firm tofu
ingredients.original: A few 1 cm cubes of medium-firm tofu

ingredients.name: (about 15 ml) miso paste (either white, red, or a mixture)
ingredients.original: 1 tablespoon (about 15 ml) miso paste (either white, red, or a mixture)

steps: Heat the dashi to a light simmer.
While this is heating, lay out your bowl and place the wakame and tofu in the bottom.
When the dashi simmers, take a ladle or so of liquid aside and mix it with the miso paste.
Remove the pot of dashi from the stove and stir in the miso mixture.
Ladle the prepared soup into the bowl and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Roasted Oysters
steps: Rinse the oysters in a colander and drain well.
Put the live oysters in the shell in a large sauté pan on medium-high heat and leave them till their shells open a little.
Take them off the heat, open them on a plate, and season with salt and pepper.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Soup Dashi (Japanese Soup Stock)

ingredients.name: handfuls dried, smoked, thinly-shaved skipjack tuna (katsuobushi)
ingredients.original: 3 large handfuls dried, smoked, thinly-shaved skipjack tuna (katsuobushi)

ingredients.name: ea. 4-inch (10 cm) long sheets of kombu seaweed
ingredients.original: 4–5 ea. 4-inch (10 cm) long sheets of kombu seaweed

steps: Cut small gashes into the kombu. Do not wash the kombu; the white powder on the exterior is actually natural, crystallized MSG and gives the soup flavour.
Place the kombu into the water and bring it to a boil, skimming the surface periodically
Just as the water begins to simmer, remove the kombu (this may be re-infused with less water a second time to make a lower-quality dashi suitable for cooking)
Let the stock cool down for approximately 5 minutes
Add the flaked tuna and stir, returning to heat
Permit it to boil for about 30 seconds and remove from heat

After a few minutes, the fish will sink to the bottom. Strain the stock through a fine mesh filter (cheesecloth works well), squeezing the fish to extract every bit of juice (this may be re-infused as well)
Store in the fridge for up to 5 days, and in the freezer for up to 6 months

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Spaghetti

ingredients.name: pasta sauce (optional but recommended)
ingredients.original: 2.5 cups (24 oz) pasta sauce (optional but recommended)

steps: On a stovetop, bring the water to a boil on high heat after adding salt and vegetable oil (see tips below).
Reduce heat to medium and add the pasta.
While the spaghetti is cooking, pour desired amount of sauce into pan and set stove to medium.

Set a timer for 7 minutes. When the timer goes off, fish out a strand of spaghetti and bite into it. What you're going for here is al dente, meaning that the pasta is just soft enough to eat: no longer crunchy in the middle, and not mushy and over-done. A more traditional (but messy) way to see if the spaghetti is done is to throw some strands onto a wall. If they stick to the wall, then the pasta is ready to eat.
When the sauce begins to bubble, reduce the heat to its lowest setting and cover.
Once the pasta is ready, carefully drain it through a colander into a sink.
Serve sauce over pasta in bowls.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Syrup
steps: Combine the sugar and cold water in a saucepan.
Bring the water to a boil over high heat, stirring constantly.
When all of the sugar has dissolved, remove from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature. This should only take a few minutes.
Transfer to a storage container, and refrigerate until needed.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Simple Tarragon Quiche

ingredients.name: Swiss cheese
ingredients.original: ¾ cup (180 ml) freshly-grated Swiss cheese

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place the eggs, cream, tarragon, nutmeg, salt, and pepper in a blender; blend as briefly as possible until they form a homogeneous mixture.
In the pie crust, create alternating layers of the shredded cheese and the mixture from the blender until the crust is full.
Bake the quiche for 35–40 minutes; a toothpick or fork inserted into its middle should come out "clean".
Remove the quiche from the oven, and let it cool for at least 20 minutes before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sinasir (Nigerian Rice Pancake)
steps: Place the rice in a bowl, and cover it with about 1 inch of water. Soak for several hours.
Blend the soaked and parboiled rice in a blender until you get a smooth batter, adding water as necessary.
Transfer the batter to a bowl, then mix in the yeast and sugar. Cover and let ferment at room temperature for a few hours.
Mix in onion, salt, and baking powder.
Heat a non-stick frying pan, and grease with a thin layer of oil.
Scoop in enough batter to make a thin layer in the pan. Cook until the bottom is browned and the pancake is cooked through.
Remove the pancake, and repeat the greasing and cooking process with the remaining batter.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sincronizada (Fried Ham and Cheese Tortilla Sandwich)
steps: Heat up some oil in a pan over medium heat.
On a cutting board, with two tortillas, place a slice of deli ham and then queso fresco in the middle, and place another tortilla on top.
When the oil is hot, place the raw sincronizada on the pan and let the first side brown for a few minutes until the outside becomes crispy.
Once the first side is golden brown, flip the sincronizada over and brown the other side to crisp up in the same manner.
After a few more minutes, place the sincronizada on a plate with napkins, and enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sindhi Chickpea Confection
steps: Heat the ghee in a pan. Add the gram flour, and stir until toasted.
Remove from the heat, and stir in the sugar.
Return to the heat, and stir until the sugar melts.
Transfer mixture to a bowl, and garnish with nuts.
Serve hot or cold.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sindhi Fried Potatoes
steps: Heat enough oil in a pot for deep frying.
Add the potatoes and deep fry until golden brown.
Remove potatoes from the oil, and place on paper towels to drain.
Transfer potatoes to a serving plate. Sprinkle with salt, chili powder, coriander, and pepper.
Serve hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sindhi Pulao
steps: Heat some oil in a pot, and add the onions. Fry until dark brown.
Add the chiles, curry leaves, cashews, garam masala, pepper, chili powder, bay leaf, and salt.
Add the rice and enough water to cook the rice. Simmer uncovered until all the water is absorbed.
Serve hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sindhi Raitha
steps: Combine all ingredients together.
Serve cool.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sindhi Spiced Fish
steps: Shallow fry the fish on one side, then transfer it to a pan fried-side down.
Combine yogurt, onions, coriander leaves, green chile, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, and tamarind paste.
Spread the yogurt mixture over the fish. Bake until golden.
Serve with chapatis.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sindhi Spiced Moong Dal
steps: Soak the dal in water for 1 hour. Drain.
Combine the dal, chiles, and ginger in a pot. Do not add salt.
Cover the dal with water. Boil in a pressure cooker for at least 3–4 minutes.
Transfer the dal to a bowl. Season with salt, coriander, and pepper.
Sprinkle with chili powder, and drizzle with some oil.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sindhi Vegetable Kofta
steps: Combine the water, a pinch of salt, and cornstarch. It should be thick and not watery.
Combine the carrot, cauliflower, mashed potatoes, bell pepper, chiles, salt to taste, pepper, and garam masala.
Wet the bread, squeeze it out, and mix it into the vegetables.
Shape the vegetable mixture into small balls. Dip the balls in the cornstarch mixture to coat well.
Fry balls in a pan of hot oil until golden brown. Remove from the oil and place on paper towels.
Fry the onions in a pan with a little oil until golden brown. Add the tomatoes, and fry until the tomatoes and the oil separate.
Add a little water, along with salt to taste, chili powder, and coriander powder. Bring to a boil.
Add the fried kofta to the sauce, and cook for a while.
Remove from the heat, and mix in the garam masala and pepper.
Serve hot with roti, naan, or rice.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sinigang (Philippine Sour Soup)

ingredients.name: Sampaloc (tamarind) fruits or ready-to-use tamarind paste
ingredients.original: Sampaloc (tamarind) fruits or ready-to-use tamarind paste

ingredients.name: taro root, diced or sliced into chunks
ingredients.original: 250 g taro root, diced or sliced into chunks

ingredients.name: string beans, cut in 1-inch pieces
ingredients.original: 200 g string beans, cut in 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: kangkung (water spinach) leaves or other leafy yet crunchy vegetable even when cooked.
ingredients.original: 250 g kangkung (water spinach) leaves or other leafy yet crunchy vegetable even when cooked.

ingredients.name: green chiles (e.g. serrano or any other fragrant and mild variety)
ingredients.original: 3 green chiles (e.g. serrano or any other fragrant and mild variety)

steps: If using whole tamarind, boil it in water until the shells crack, then work the flesh away from the seeds and strain, reserving all the liquid for the soup. Skip this process if using packed tamarind base.
Sauté the chopped onions in another large pot.
Add the tomato and pork to the onions, and sauté until the pork is no longer pink.
Add enough water or boiled tamarind stock to cover the contents of the pot. Boil until tender.
Add taro root, and simmer until soft and tender. The soup should to thicken at this point.
Add the horseradish, and simmer until tender-crunchy.
Add the string beans, quartered onions, and water spinach. Simmer for another 2–3 minutes.
Check to make sure all ingredients were cooked enough, then add the tamarind pack if using.
Add fish sauce, salt, pepper, and MSG to taste. Top with green chillies.
Serve hot.

ingredients.name: oregano, parsley or any other dry green spice
ingredients.original: oregano, parsley or any other dry green spice

steps: Take two small earthware pots with lids ("gyuveche" pots), add a layer of cheese, then a layer of peppers and tomatoes, then more cheese. Season with spices as you layer.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Break an egg on top of each dish, and cook until the egg is the consistency you like.
Serve with salad and beer. Enjoy!

ingredients.name: Sour cream and sugar or jam, confiture.

Take piece of paste, make round, flat shape and put on warm frying pan with oil or melted butter.
Wait until it becomes gold colour and flip.
When it is brown on both sides you can eat it.

Mix the soup and water and pour over all.
Add salt and pepper on top.
Bake about 1.5–2 hours at 350°F.

ingredients.name: kilo of pig's lungs, grilled and minced
ingredients.original: ½ kilo of pig's lungs, grilled and minced

ingredients.name: vinegar (sukang iloko would be good)

Boil pork head until tender.
Take out all the meat and dice.
In a sauté pan, heat oil and sauté garlic, onion, red pepper, pork meat and liver.
Season with liquid seasoning, black pepper, and brown sugar.

recipes.title: Skillet Cornbread

ingredients.name: yellow or white cornmeal
ingredients.original: 1 ¼ cups yellow or white cornmeal

ingredients.name: melted butter or pan drippings
ingredients.original: 2–3 tbsp melted butter or pan drippings

steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C)
Grease the skillet with bacon drippings (ideal) or oil. Butter isn't recommended, since it can burn when you preheat the skillet.
Preheat the skillet until the drippings/oil is smoking. This ensures a good crust on the bottom of the cornbread.
In a bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt. Thoroughly mix the sifted ingredients together and add the corn meal.
In a second bowl, beat the egg well. Add the melted butter (or pan drippings) and the milk and continue to beat until well mixed.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix using fast strokes. Take care not to overmix.

Pour the batter into the skillet and place in the oven. Bake for 25-30 minutes. The cornbread should have a golden brown color when done, and a knitting needle or knife-point will come out "dry" when inserted in the bread.

ingredients.name: uncooked lasagne noodles, broken into squares
ingredients.original: 10 uncooked lasagne noodles, broken into squares

Add noodles and cook until tender.
Preparing the Meat: Meanwhile, brown the ground beef in heavy skillet. Drain grease.
Add pasta sauce, water, dressing, and bell pepper.
Stir until well combined and bell pepper is tender.
Cover and let simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Drain noodles and add to meat. Stir until well combined.
Cover and let stand under low heat for 5 minutes.
Add cheese and stir well, then turn off heat and let cool.

Dice bacon and fry it in a pan.

Drain the cabbage, and toss with the bacon and onion.

Cook the hamburger patty.
Cook the chili.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes

ingredients.name: green bell pepper
ingredients.original: ¼ cup chopped green bell pepper (optional)

steps: Brown the ground beef, onions, and peppers in skillet on medium heat.
Drain the liquid from the mixture.
Place the ground beef back on the skillet.
While on medium heat mix in the ketchup, barbecue sauce, garlic powder, and chili powder in any order.
Simmer for 20 minutes.

The next day, combine remaining ingredients. Place ribs in the bottom of a slow cooker and pour mixture over.
Cover and cook on low for 8–9 hours, or until ribs are tender. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Chops

ingredients.name: firmly packed dark brown sugar
ingredients.original: 2 tbsp firmly packed dark brown sugar

steps: Brush chops with olive oil and season liberally with chop rub. Set aside.
Heat a large stainless steel or cast iron skillet over high heat. Add pork chops and cook until browned and slightly charred on both sides.
Remove and set aside.
Place pan back on heat and deglaze with white wine. Pour out wine and reserve.
Place apples in the bottom of a crockpot. Place pork chops on top and drizzle with remaining ingredients.
Cook on low 7–8 hours.
Drain apples and pork into a large saucepan. Bring liquid to a boil over high heat until reduced by half.
Pour liquid back over pork chops and serve warm.

ingredients.name: condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.original: 1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of celery soup

steps: Put chicken in crock pot.
Mix together cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup.
Pour soup mixture over chicken in crock pot.
Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Strip Steak
steps: Heat a large cast iron skillet over high heat for 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, brush steaks liberally with extra-virgin olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Place steaks in pan and cook until browned and slightly charred on both sides. Remove to a roasting rack set in a roasting pan.
Insert a probe thermometer into one of the steaks and bake at 225°F until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium-rare.
Remove steaks from pan and keep warm.
Skim fat from drippings and place pan on high heat on two burners. Deglaze pan with broth. Bring to a boil and cook until liquid has reduced by ⅔.
Remove pan from heat and add wine. Once alcohol has cooked off, place pan back on two burners. Cook until liquid has reduced by ⅔.
Pour into a squirt bottle. Make a fancy plate with the sauce and serve warm.

recipes.title: Smoked Eulachons
steps: Wash the eulachons well under running water.
In a barrel, mix a brine solution of water and enough salt to make a potato float. A good ratio is 2 cups (500 ml) coarse salt in 3 gallons (12 litres) water. Add the fish.
Soak for about ½–1 hour, or until the fish eyes turn white.
Hang the eulachons for smoking by threading on cedar sticks. Push the strip of red cedar in through the gills and out through the mouth. Usually 12–25 eulachons are put on each stick.
Hang the sticks from the rafters in a smokehouse, making sure the fish are not touching each other. There needs to be enough space between each rack and the fish so that the smoke is even.
Let the fish finish dripping, then start the smoking fire with alder wood.
Smoke the eulachon for 2–6 days. Smoke longer to make drier fish.

recipes.title: Smoked Garlic Chicken

ingredients.name: whole chicken leg quarters, skin removed
ingredients.original: 4 whole chicken leg quarters, skin removed

steps: Combine seasonings. Set aside.
Brush chicken with mustard. This will help make a crust. Press seasoning mixture into both sides of meat. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Preheat smoker to 225°F with mesquite. Add chicken pieces and insert a probe thermometer into one of them. Cook, adding wood as needed, until internal temperature reaches 170°F.
Move to a very very high grill and cook until charred and marked. Flip and repeat.
Serve immediately with desired side dishes.

recipes.title: Smoked Pork Roast

ingredients.name: ea. (4 pounds) boneless pork loin roast, trimmed of excess fat
ingredients.original: 1 ea. (4 pounds) boneless pork loin roast, trimmed of excess fat

steps: Combine salt, honey, and vinegar in a 6-quart container. Add ice, cover, and shake until ice is mostly melted and brine has cooled.
Add pork roast, toss to coat, and weigh down if needed. Refrigerate 3–3.5 hours.
Take roast out of brine; rinse with cold water. Pat dry with paper towels and set aside.
Combine seasonings and sugar. Press into all sides of meat. Set aside.
Preheat smoker to 200°F with the hickory chunks. Add roast, cover, and cook until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium rare.
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with foil. Let rest 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Breakfast Burrito

ingredients.original: ¼ cup smoked salmon cream cheese spread

steps: In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, lemon juice, and pepper.
In sauté pan over medium heat, add oil to coat the pan, add egg mixture to scramble.
Toast the tortillas in a cast iron skillet over medium heat. Spread cream spread in a circle with 2 inches from the edge of tortilla. Add eggs.
Wrap and enjoy.

steps: Place stock pot over medium heat, add oil.
Add carrots, onions, celery, stirring until onions turn clear.
Add tarragon and salmon stock to deglaze bottom of pan.
Stir in smashed potatoes, smoked salmon. Continue to stir and bring to a simmer.
Add milk and pepper.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Dip
steps: In medium-sized bowl, crumble salmon; add cream cheese, sour cream, lemon juice, and pepper.
Mix until well incorporated or creamy.
Mix in basil and parsley.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Ravioli Filling
steps: Mix the salmon, chives, lemon zest and seasonings in a bowl until salmon is well coated.
Mix the ricotta or cottage cheese, egg, and Parmesan cheese.
Add to the salmon and mix until well blended but not homogeneous.
Cover and refrigerate until the dough is ready.

recipes.title: Smokehouse Burgers

ingredients.name: hamburger buns, split in half and toasted
ingredients.original: 4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted

steps: Form meat into 4 equal patties, about ¾ inch thick. Make a depression in the center with your thumb and set aside.
Brush patties with oil. Sprinkle on both sides with seasonings.

Preheat grill. Add patties and cook, turning often, until desired "doneness" is achieved. Remove to a plate, top each with a slice of cheese, and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Let rest until cheese is melted.
Brush cut sides of bread with oil. Add a patty onto the bottom half of a bun, then top with the upper half. Repeat with remaining meat and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Smokehouse Turkey Panini
steps: Assemble a sandwich with the turkey, bread, bacon, and cheese. Set aside.
Preheat 2-burner grill pan over medium high heat.
Brush both sides of sandwiches with oil then place on grill.
Cook until ingredients are heated through and bread is marked, turning as needed. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Smokey Millet Super Grain Bowl With Crispy Tofu

ingredients.name: walnuts, lightly toasted and finely chopped
ingredients.original: 1 cup walnuts, lightly toasted and finely chopped

ingredients.name: ears of corn, off the cob
ingredients.original: 4 ears of corn, off the cob

ingredients.name: gluten-free baked tofu, teriyaki flavor, diced into 1/4-inch squares
ingredients.original: 2 packages gluten-free baked tofu, teriyaki flavor, diced into ¼-inch squares (optional)

ingredients.name: chipotle pepper in adobo sauce
ingredients.original: 1–2 tsp chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, chopped

steps: Cook the millet per the package instructions using water or vegetable stock. Once cooked, remove from the pan and place in a medium size mixing bowl. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly toast the walnuts until fragrant, about 8 minutes. Set aside to cool. When cool enough to handle, finely chop and add to the cooked millet.

Place a large sauté pan oven medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil. When hot, but not smoking, add the corn. Add ½ teaspoon of salt and stir to incorporate. Cook until the corn is a vibrant yellow color, about 4–5 minutes. Add the scallions and cook an additional 30 seconds. Remove form the heat and place in the bowl with the millet.

Place the pan you used for the corn back on a medium-high heat. Add an additional 1 tablespoon of olive oil. When hot, add the cauliflower rice, ½ teaspoon salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and beginning to brown. Remove from the heat and add to the millet mixture.

Wipe out the pan and add 2 tablespoons olive oil. When hot, add the diced tofu and remaining ½ teaspoon salt and cook, stirring occasionally as needed until the tofu begins to brown and get crispy, about 7–8 minutes. Remove from the heat and add to the millet-mixture.
Add the desired amount of chipotle to the millet-tofu mixture based on your desired heat preference. Adjust the seasoning as needed. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and toss to coat.
To serve, divide among serving bowls. Garnish with sliced radishes and chopped chives. This grain bowl can be served at warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Smoking Shrimp Creole

ingredients.name: or medium shrimp, shelled
ingredients.original: ¾ pound small or medium shrimp, shelled

steps: Heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté the onion, celery, pepper, and garlic until the onion is translucent, 4–5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, bay leaves, paprika, and chipotle chili.
Simmer the sauce, uncovered, until it is thick, 15–20 minutes, stirring it 2–3 times.
Add the shrimp and cook, uncovered, until they are pink and firm, 5–7 minutes, depending on their size.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Combine remaining ingredients, add wings, and toss to coat. Serve.

ingredients.original: 1 container (4.5 oz) hickory smoke-flavored albacore tuna

steps: Combine tuna, melted butter, and lemon juice.
Spread some of the tuna mixture on each slice of bread. Top with cheese.
Broil until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Smore (Eurasian Beef Stew)

ingredients.name: carrots, peeled and sliced diagonally
ingredients.original: 100 g small carrots, peeled and sliced diagonally

steps: Marinating: Wash and cut beef into 2.5 cm chunks.
Drain in colander.
Combine beef with bicarbonate of soda, pepper, salt, sugar, vinegar and dark soya sauce.
Leave for 30 minutes to marinate.
Cooking: Grind onions and garlic together.
Soak carrots and potatoes in water.
Heat oil in a pot. When hot, fry ground onion and garlic, shredded ginger, and cinnamon until the onions are brown and fragrant.
Add marinated beef. Fry until meat changes color.
Add water and simmer until meat is tender. Stir occasionally to prevent meat from sticking to pot. Add more water if gravy is too thick, and season accordingly.
Add carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add potatoes and cook until soft.
Add tomato. If you like, you may add a tin of Spam luncheon meat, cut into thick slices or chicken franks at this step.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

recipes.title: Smothered Okra
steps: Remove okra tips and heads, and slice into ¼–½ inch wide pieces.
Sauté onion, celery, and bell pepper in butter until soft over medium heat, adding garlic to sauté shortly before the onion is soft.
Add okra and tomatoes. Stir a few times to incorporate. If the mixture seems a bit dry, add a small amount of water.
Simmer over medium heat until the okra is no longer sticky and stringy. The okra will change to a darker green color.
Serve over rice or freeze to use in your next gumbo.

recipes.title: Snails with Garlic Butter (Escargots à la Bourguignonne)

ingredients.name: snail shells, with snail serving dishes, and snail tongs OR 4 glazed indented earthenware snail serving dishes OR 24 small mushroom caps, trimmed and de-gilled
ingredients.original: 24 snail shells, with snail serving dishes, and snail tongs OR 4 glazed indented earthenware snail serving dishes OR 24 small mushroom caps, trimmed and de-gilled

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain and rinse the snails.
Combine the butter with the shallots, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper, and blend well.
Sauté the mushroom caps, if using, in a small amount of garlic butter until cooked but still firm. Remove from the heat.

If using snail shells, place a snail in each shell and fill the rest of the space with garlic butter. If using a snail dish without the shells, place a snail in each indentation and fill the rest of the space with garlic butter. If using mushroom caps, place 2–3 snails in each cap and top with a generous amount of garlic butter.
Heat the snails in the oven for 5–7 minutes, and serve with copious quantities of French bread for soaking up the garlic butter.

Beat in molasses and egg.
Combine the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, and salt.
Stir into molasses alternating with water.
Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups ⅔ full.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until a wooden toothpick comes out clean.

ingredients.original: 1 liter of plain yogurt (two regular containers in Bulgaria)

ingredients.name: pickles or cucumbers or mixed
ingredients.original: ½ kg pickles or cucumbers or mixed

ingredients.name: seasoned salt (like "Vegeta") or salt (use no salt if you are using salty pickles)

Beat in the eggs.

Alternately mix the flour and milk into the batter to make a dough.
Drop dough on a greased or lined baking sheet in spoonfuls.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Bake in a quick oven.

Add eggs.
Dissolve baking soda in milk, then add.
Add flour, cream of tartar and salt.
Beat the batter thoroughly.
Pour in shallow pans.
Dust the top of the cake with cinnamon and sugar.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles I

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.original: 344 g (2 ¾ cups or 24 oz) all-purpose flour

ingredients.name: white sugar
ingredients.original: 300 g (1 ½ cups or 12 oz) white sugar

ingredients.name: soft shortening
ingredients.original: 205 g (1 cup or 8 oz) soft shortening

steps: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Combine the flour, salt, baking soda, and cream of tartar.
Cream together the sugar and shortening. Beat in the eggs.
Mix the flour mixture into the batter to make a dough.
Shape dough into little balls, then transfer to a greased or parchment-lined lined baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
Sprinkle generously with cinnamon while hot.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles II

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.original: 344 g (2 ¾ cups or 24 oz) all-purpose flour

ingredients.name: white sugar
ingredients.original: 200 g (1 cups or 6 oz) white sugar

ingredients.name: soft shortening
ingredients.original: 100 g (½ cup or 4 oz) soft shortening

steps: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Mix flour, salt, baking soda, cream of tartar, sugar, shortening, and butter.
Roll into 1 tbsp balls.
Mix sugar and cinnamon.
Roll balls in sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Bake for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
Sprinkle generously with cinnamon while hot.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles III

ingredients.name: butter, softened (not melted)
ingredients.original: 227 g (2 cups or 16 oz) butter, softened (not melted)

ingredients.name: vinegar
ingredients.original: 220 ml (1 cup or 8 fl oz) vinegar

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.original: 188 g (1 ½ cups or 12 oz) all-purpose flour

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C or Gas Mark 5)
In a medium mixing bowl, beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds.
Add the 1 cup sugar, baking soda, cream of tartar, and vinegar. Beat until combined, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
Beat in egg and vanilla until combined.
Beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer. Stir in any remaining flour.
Cover and chill dough for 1–2 hours or until easy to handle.
Combine the 2 tbsp sugar and the cinnamon in a small bowl.
Shape dough into 1-inch (2.5 cm) balls. Roll balls in cinnamon-sugar to coat. Place balls 2 inches (5 cm) apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 10–11 minutes or until edges are golden. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles IV

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.original: 344 g (2 ¾ cups or 24 oz) all-purpose flour

ingredients.name: superfine sugar
ingredients.original: 300 g (1½ cups or 9 oz) superfine sugar

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix flour, salt, baking soda, cream of tartar. Set aside.
Beat butter, shortening and sugar.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Gradually add dry ingredients, mixing fully.
Roll into 1 tbsp balls.
Mix sugar and cinnamon.
Roll balls in sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Bake for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
Let cool completely before eating.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Socca (Italian Chickpea Flatbread)

ingredients.name: Black pepper to taste; 2–3 decent grinds of a grinder should do
ingredients.original: Black pepper to taste; 2–3 decent grinds of a grinder should do

steps: Heat oven as high as it can go—around 300°C / 570°F is traditional, but do whatever your oven can manage that gets close to this. If using a cast-iron pan, get it into the oven at the start so that it is hot when the batter goes into it.
Whisk all the ingredients together well, ensuring there are no lumps. This should make a very thin, easy-to-pour batter.

Once the oven is up to temperature, pour some of the batter into the hot pan or onto the plaque, and put into the oven for 8–9 minutes at 300°C / 570°F, or 13–15 minutes at 250°C / 480°F. With a 50 cm plaque or pan, cook half the batter at a time—the batter should cover the plaque or pan very thinly.
Remove from the oven and cut into triangular wedges. Serve hot.
Repeat for the rest of the batter.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sockerdricka (Swedish Ginger Drink)
steps: Boil the sugar, water, lemon and crushed ginger for 15 minutes.
Strain the mixture and let it cool.
Mix in the yeast and let the mixture ferment for 2 days.
Put the drink in bottles, and add a raisin to each bottle.
Cork the bottles, and let rest for 5 days. After 5 days the sockerdricka is ready for drinking.
