Bake for 15–20 minutes or until lightly brown.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Duck Breast with Cabbage and Dumplings

ingredients.name: ea. (about 2.5 kg) whole fresh duck, at room temperature
ingredients.original: 1 ea. (about 2.5 kg) whole fresh duck, at room temperature

ingredients.name: stale white bread rolls, cut into small cubes
ingredients.original: 4 stale white bread rolls, cut into small cubes

steps: Cabbage salad: Put the shredded cabbage and the minced onion into a large bowl.
Combine vinegar, salt, and sugar in a separate bowl and pour the mixture over the cabbage.
Cover the salad, and refrigerate it for several hours before serving.
Duck: Preheat the oven to 200°C. If not already done, disembowel the duck, remove the clumps of fat from the tail, and rinse the whole bird carefully.
Grease the bird with butter all over, and season it generously inside and out with salt, pepper, and marjoram.
Stuff the duck with the peeled apples and make sure to close it appropriately. This will give a wonderful taste to the finished dish.
Put the duck breast-side up into a roasting pan that is deep enough to hold the rendered fat, and roast it at 200°C for around 15 minutes.

Take out the duck, baste it, turn it breast-side down, and roast for another 15 minutes. Continue to do so every 15 minutes. It takes roughly an hour to roast 1 kg; thus, you may prepare yourself to leave the duck in the oven for about 2½ hours.
About 20 minutes before the end of the roasting process, put some more butter on the duck in order to obtain a crispy skin. The duck is ready to be served when its skin is richly browned and crisp.
Turn off the oven and let the duck rest for another 10 minutes.
Bread dumplings: Put the bread cubes into a large bowl and pour milk over them; use more or less milk depending on how dry the bread is.
Melt the butter in a pan, and mix it with the eggs and the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Add to the bread mixture.
Use your hands to squeeze the bread mixture through your fingers until it is smooth and sticky. If the dough is too loose, add 1–2 tablespoons of flour to firm it up.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and form small portions of the dough into balls.

Drop the dumplings carefully into the water and let them simmer for about 30 minutes until they are light, firm, and well risen. Remove them with a large spoon. Alternatively, form the dough into a roll, wrap it into a wet dishtowel, and firmly tie up both ends. Then, put it into the pot and let it simmer for about 30 minutes.
Serving: Remove the apples from the duck, then carve it as desired. Put the dark brown gravy into an extra cup for serving.

If you have cooked the dumpling mixture using the towel method, remove the large dumpling from the dishtowel, cut it into generous slices, and arrange them nicely on a plate. Otherwise, transfer the drained cooked dumplings to a dish.
Serve the duck and dumplings hot, accompanied by the cabbage salad and a fruity red wine.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed French Toast

ingredients.name: (2/3 inch thick) stale brioche bread
ingredients.original: 4 slices (⅔ inch thick) stale brioche bread

steps: Spread cream cheese on half the bread. Press into sort of a sandwich and set aside.
Combine egg, vanilla, cream, sugar, and salt in a pie pan. Add bread "sandwiches" to mixture and coat both sides.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a small nonstick skillet heated between medium and medium high. Add 1 "sandwich" to pan and cook until golden brown on both sides.
Remove from pan. Melt remaining butter and repeat.
Serve immediately with maple syrup, powdered sugar, whipped cream, or fresh fruit.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Grape Leaves

ingredients.name: Batch of thin, freshly-picked grape leaves (choose only the thinnest leaves)
ingredients.original: Batch of thin, freshly-picked grape leaves (choose only the thinnest leaves)

steps: Soak leaves in boiling hot water to soften, about 15 minutes.
Combine the rice, turmeric, pepper, salt, mint, raisins, dill, parsley and green onions.

Place some of the rice mixture on a leaf, close to one end. Fold the three smaller ends of the leaf over the filling, then roll up the remainder like a sleeping bag or mat. Repeat with remaining rice and leaves.
Place stuffed leaves in pot with a little water, oil, and lemon juice—the liquid should just barely cover the stuffed leaves.
Cover pot with lid. First bring to a boil, then lower heat.
Cook over low heat until the rice is cooked.
Place sliced lemon on top of stuffed grape leaves for added flavour, and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Grilled Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: Grill Seasoning for Chicken, as needed
ingredients.original: Grill Seasoning for Chicken, as needed

ingredients.name: poultry stuffing (prepared to a somewhat wet and pipeable state)
ingredients.original: 1½ cups poultry stuffing (prepared to a somewhat wet and pipeable state)

steps: Using a narrow boning knife, make a slit along the side of one of the chicken breasts, almost cutting through all the way through the side. Repeat with remaining chicken.

Place stuffing inside a gallon size zip-top bag. Snip a small hole in one of the corners. Squeeze to dispense. Stuff each chicken breast until slit fills up halfway. Brush opening edge with Dijon mustard and press down lightly.
Coat chicken with mustard and season liberally with Grill Seasoning. Massage seasoning in.
Quickly swab preheated charcoal grill with oil soaked towel. Grill chicken, turning often, until area under stuffing reaches 165°F (75°C) and stuffing reaches 165°F (75°C).
Remove and let rest for 7 minutes. Serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Kabocha Squash
steps: Cut off top of kabocha squash and scoop out seeds.
Bake the squash for 45 minutes at 375°F (190°C) or until a sharp knife goes through the flesh easily.
Meanwhile, fry the tempeh, shallots, ginger, and jalapeño. Cook until tempeh is completely brown, and then add soy sauce and rice. Take off heat and mix thoroughly.
Put tempeh mixture into kabocha squash and bake for 30 more minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms with Crabmeat

ingredients.name: sour cream or plain yogurt
ingredients.original: ½ cup (120 ml) sour cream or plain yogurt

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Remove and finely chop mushroom stems.
In a bowl, combine chopped mushroom stems, vegetable soup mix, crabmeat, sour cream, bread crumbs, dill, hot pepper sauce, and pepper. Set aside.
On lightly greased baking sheet, arrange mushroom caps; stuff with crabmeat mixture, then brush with butter.
Bake 15 minutes or until tender.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.name: ground meat (either beef, lamb, or pork)
ingredients.original: 1 pound (500 g) ground meat (either beef, lamb, or pork)

steps: Cook the rice.
Turn on the oven to preheat at 390°F (200°C), while placing a baking dish with the bottom covered in oil (or water or thin tomato sauce) inside.
Cut out the stems and the seeds of the peppers so that the peppers form a cup.
Mix the rice, the egg and the ground beef and spice everything with salt, pepper and paprika.
Fill the peppers, set them into the baking dish, and bake for 45 minutes.
Serve with green salad and tomato sauce.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers (Vegetarian)
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut onion into small cubes and fry in olive oil until brown.
Add water, tomato juice, parsley, soup cube, cheese, garlic, black olives and rice. Season to taste.
Fill into the peppers. Cook for 30 minutes. Rest as above.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pork Roast

ingredients.name: ea. (3–4 pounds) boneless pork loin roast
ingredients.original: 1 ea. (3–4 pounds) boneless pork loin roast

ingredients.name: egg whites, beaten to stiff peaks with 1/8 tsp cream of tartar
ingredients.original: 4 egg whites, beaten to stiff peaks with ⅛ tsp cream of tartar

steps: Combine salt, honey, and vinegar in a gallon size zip-top bag until salt is dissolved. Add ice and shake until brine has cooled down and ice is almost completely melted.
Add pork roast and toss to coat. Refrigerate 3–4 hours.
Combine bread, and fruit. Gently fold eggs into bread mixture. Set aside.
Almost split the roast horizontally, not cutting through either the sides or the bottom. Pack stuffing into pocket and brush edge of opening with Dijon mustard. Press closed.
Brush all sides of roast with mustard. Press peppercorns into meat and place in a rack in a roasting pan.
Insert a probe thermometer into an area of the center of the roast that does not have stuffing. Bake in a 425°F oven until internal temperature reaches at least 145°F.
Remove to a plate and let rest 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with cider gravy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Portabella Mushrooms

ingredients.name: mozzarella cheese (fresh or regular), diced or grated
ingredients.original: 4 oz mozzarella cheese (fresh or regular), diced or grated

ingredients.name: Saltine crackers, crushed or 1/2 cup bread crumbs
ingredients.original: 10 Saltine crackers, crushed or ½ cup bread crumbs

steps: Generously sprinkle vinegar over the mushrooms, and top with garlic. Leave for 30 minutes or so.
Combine the egg, cheeses, crackers and seasonings in a bowl. Mix well. Spoon the mixture onto the mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Squash

ingredients.name: winter squashes, depending on size (red kuri, blue hubbard, acorn, or other round-ish winter squash)
ingredients.original: 1–4 winter squashes, depending on size (red kuri, blue hubbard, acorn, or other round-ish winter squash)

steps: Roasting: Cut off the top of the squash and dig out the soft insides and seeds. Throw away the insides and seeds.
Coat the squash, inside and out, with a thin layer of olive oil. Salt and pepper the inside.
Place in a 350°F oven and roast until a fork easily pierces the flesh (about 30–45 minutes).
While the squash is roasting, prepare the stuffing (below).
Stuffing: Heat almond oil in a large pot. Add the slivered almonds, some red pepper flakes, and a little salt, and sauté the almonds until lightly browned and fragrant.
Add the onion and continue to sauté until translucent, at which point you should add the garlic and red bell pepper and sauté for 1–2 more minutes.
Mix in the rice pilaf mix, coating the mixture with the almond oil. Stir this around until the rice is hot and lightly toasted (3–5 minutes, or less).
Add 2½ cups water or broth and bring it to an open boil. Cover the pan and turn down the heat to let it simmer until the rice is cooked (about 30–45 minutes).
Salt and pepper to taste.
When the rice is done, pour it into the roasted squash. Grate the cheese on top. Broil a few minutes until the cheese is bubbly and toasty.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tomatoes

ingredients.name: onion slab, or coin, about 1/4 inch (0.5 cm) thick
ingredients.original: 1 sliced onion slab, or coin, about ¼ inch (0.5 cm) thick

ingredients.name: fresh basil leaves or 2 tsp dried basil
ingredients.original: 4 fresh basil leaves or 2 tsp dried basil

ingredients.name: fresh parsley or 2 tsp dried parsley flakes
ingredients.original: 2 tbsp fresh parsley or 2 tsp dried parsley flakes

steps: On the head of a fresh tomato, cut two concentric rings, one near the stem, the other near the slope of the tomato's shoulder.
Remove this ring to expose the juicy seed compartments.
Slice the mushrooms into small, flat slabs, and cut the onion coin in quarters, like a pie or quiche. Separate the layers.
In the open ring sprinkle the dried spices.

Force the mushrooms and small arcs of onion through the spices and into the seed compartments, pushing the basil/dill/parsley/etc in with them. Stuff in as many as possible without forcing out tomato pulp. If using fresh basil leaves, fold them over the slices of mushrooms and push them in together.
Drizzle five or so drops of cooking oil in a spot on a baking sheet or small roasting flat. Rub in a small circle with a diameter equal to the foot, or butt of the tomato.
Place the tomato on the oil and the pan into an oven preheated to 350°F (180°C).
Roast for 15–20 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffed Zucchini

ingredients.name: frozen spinach, thawed and drained
ingredients.original: 10 oz (280 g) chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained

ingredients.name: button mushrooms (canned or fresh)
ingredients.original: 8–10 oz (220–280 g) button mushrooms (canned or fresh), finely chopped

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Trim ends of zucchini and boil, covered, for 5 minutes. Drain and cover.
Cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop out pulp, leaving a ¼ inch (0.75 cm) shell. Chop the removed pulp.
Heat olive oil in sauté pan.
Sauté zucchini pulp, spinach, onions, and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and sauté another 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, add eggs, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Spoon filling into shells.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake for 30 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Stuffing

ingredients.name: white bread (just slightly stale is best)
ingredients.original: 4 slices of white bread (just slightly stale is best)

steps: Trim crusts off bread and place slices into a large mixing bowl.
Add water and all other ingredients, and with the hands, work the mixture until it is thoroughly combined.

The stuffing may be cooked by packing it into the washed cavity of chicken or turkey, prior to roasting, or by forming the stuffing into patties and placing on a greased tray in an oven (moderate temperature).

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Succotash

ingredients.name: ears of corn cut off the cob
ingredients.original: 24 ears of corn cut off the cob

steps: If using pork, cover pork with water, and parboil it.
Add beans, then corn, sugar, butter, and pepper to taste. After corn is added, watch carefully to keep from scorching.
Serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sudanese Ful Medames

ingredients.name: Optional toppings: chopped parsley, diced tomatoes, chopped onions, hard-boiled eggs, feta cheese
ingredients.original: Optional toppings: chopped parsley, diced tomatoes, chopped onions, hard-boiled eggs, feta cheese

steps: Rinse the dried fava beans under cold water and then place them in a large pot. Add 4 cups of water to the pot and let the beans soak overnight, or for at least 8 hours. This helps soften the beans and reduce the cooking time.

Drain the soaked fava beans and rinse them under cold water. Return the beans to the pot and add 4 cups of fresh water. Bring the water to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and let the beans simmer for about 1–1½ hours, or until they become tender. Stir occasionally and skim off any foam that forms on the surface.

Once the beans are tender, drain them using a colander or strainer and transfer them to a mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, extra-virgin olive oil, lemon juice, ground cumin, ground coriander, and salt to the bowl. Mix everything together, ensuring that the beans are coated evenly with the seasoning.
For a smoother consistency, you can use a fork or a potato masher to lightly mash some of the beans. This step is optional and can be adjusted according to your preference.

Transfer the seasoned ful medames to a serving dish. Ful medames can be enjoyed warm or at room temperature. You can serve it with a variety of optional toppings such as chopped parsley, diced tomatoes, chopped onions, hard-boiled eggs, or crumbled feta cheese. It is commonly served with bread or as a side dish alongside other Sudanese specialties.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sugar Pie

ingredients.name: cornstarch (flour can work if cornstarch is unavailable)
ingredients.original: ¼ cup cornstarch (flour can work if cornstarch is unavailable)

ingredients.name: Cinnamon or nutmeg to sprinkle on top of pie
ingredients.original: Cinnamon or nutmeg to sprinkle on top of pie (optional)

steps: Preheat oven to about 375°F (190–200°C)
In large saucepan, simmer milk without boiling.
Dissolve sugar, cornstarch and butter into milk. Stir gently and allow to thicken for about 5 minutes.
Pour mixture into pie crust and gently transfer into oven. Bake for about 22 minutes.
Optionally engage broiler for a few minutes to caramelize the top of the pie.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sukiyaki
steps: Wash the vegetables, and cut them into large pieces.
Soak the mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes.
Mix the sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
Heat an electric skillet on low heat, and grease with a little bit of oil.
Put a few slices of beef into the skillet, and cook them until brown.
Add sauce (don't add all of them at the same time).
Sort the beef slices to the sides. Add the rest of the ingredients in an organized fashion.
Serve the sukiyaki with bowls of rice, with a raw egg yolk as the dip. Add more ingredients as necessary.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sukuma Wiki (East African Greens)

ingredients.name: or more ground cayenne pepper
ingredients.original: ½ teaspoon or more ground cayenne pepper (optional)

steps: Heat oil in a medium-sized pot. Add onions and garlic, and stir fry for about 2–3 minutes. Don't let burn.
Stir in the tomato, coriander, curry powder, and paprika. Cook for about 2 minutes.
Stir in the meat and bouillon powder until well-mixed. Cook for at least 5 minutes.
Add the greens, cayenne, and lemon juice. Cook, stirring, for 5–10 minutes until the greens are done.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Summer Pudding

ingredients.name: loaf of white, pappy sort of bread or brioche, crusts removed and sliced
ingredients.original: 1 loaf of white, pappy sort of bread or brioche, crusts removed and sliced

ingredients.name: the best quality blackcurrant cordial you can find, in reserve
ingredients.original: 1 bottle of the best quality blackcurrant cordial you can find, in reserve

steps: Liberally butter the inside a pudding bowl about 5 inches in diameter. The bowl should preferably not be greater in diameter that the size of your pieces of sliced bread. If you are worried about getting the whole thing out of the bowl in one piece, line the bowl first with some cling film. It's a fiddly job, but ensures you get a perfect shape at the end.

Combine the blackcurrants, redcurrants, mint leaves, lime zest, sugar, and about 3 tbsp water. Poach them for about 5 minutes on the lowest possible heat setting of your stove. Add the strawberries and poach for another minute.
Turn the heat off and add the raspberries. Leave to cool.
Using the prepared bowl as a guide, cut a circle out of the white bread the same diameter as the top of the bowl. Do the same with the bottom of the bowl.

Using a sharp knife, slice the bread into squares or oblongs, roughly the same height as the bowl, which will be used to line the inside of the bowl. This does not have to be an exact science. In simple terms what we are trying to do is to line the bowl with the white bread.

Lay the smaller circle of white bread on the bottom of the bowl. Put the oblongs of white bread up the side of the bowl, overlapping slightly, and pour the fruit mixture into the void right up to the top. The bread should become well soaked in the juice from the cooked fruit. Indeed if there is not enough juice to soak the bread so it turns very red, use the cordial as a top-up.
Place the large circle, or disc, of bread on the top and press it down well.
Top with a weight or something that fits into the top of the bowl so it squashes everything down tight, and place it in the fridge for at least 40 minutes.

When you are ready to serve the pudding, carefully using a knife to release the bread mould from the side of the bowl, and invert the whole thing onto a plate. If things become a little fraught and wobbly at this point, don't panic—just sort of whack everything back into shape using a wooden spoon.
Decorate your plate with some more summer fruit, maybe a couple of mint leaves, and an artistic dollop of fresh whipped cream or crème fraîche, then serve with a flourish.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Summer Rolls

ingredients.name: cooked pork or chicken meat
ingredients.original: 50 g cooked pork or chicken meat

ingredients.name: leaves of leafy lettuce (e.g. romaine/cos, mignonette, etc.)
ingredients.original: 4 leaves of leafy lettuce (e.g. romaine/cos, mignonette, etc.)

ingredients.name: leaves of Chinese cabbage, halved lengthways
ingredients.original: 2 leaves of Chinese cabbage, halved lengthways

ingredients.name: Fresh herbs, to taste (e.g. coriander, basil, mint)
ingredients.original: Fresh herbs, to taste (e.g. coriander, basil, mint)

steps: Dip a rice wafer into the warm water and remove immediately when it is completely wet—it only needs to be in the water for a few seconds.
Lay the rice wafer on a board or plate.
Arrange a portion of the ingredients near the edge of the rice wafer in a neat pile, with the fingers of cucumber roughly parallel to the edge of the wafer.
Fold the edge of the wafer over the pile of ingredients, and roll it over once.
Fold the sides of the wafer inwards, to close of the ends of the roll you just made.
Roll the wafer up the rest of the way, to enclose the roll completely.
Set aside for 5 minutes to dry a little before eating.
The above process for each summer roll.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sunglow Motel-Cafe Pickle Pie

ingredients.name: sweet pickles, drained and ground
ingredients.original: 12 oz sweet pickles, drained and ground

steps: Beat eggs and sugar until lemon-colored and thick; beat in cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon extract, cornstarch, cream and margarine.
Stir ground sweet pickles into mixture.
Pour pickle mixture into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350°F for 1–1.25 hours, until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sunshine Cake
steps: Whip the yolks with a rotary beater until they are thick and lemon-colored.
Whip the egg whites until they are foamy, add the cream of tartar, and continue whipping until they are dry.
Fold the sugar into the egg whites, then then fold the yolks into this mixture.
Sift the flour several times and add it.
Add the lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour batter into a sponge-cake pan, and bake.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Super Foamy Milkshake

ingredients.name: locust bean gum powder
ingredients.original: 1 teaspoon (2 grams) locust bean gum powder

steps: Mix the locust bean gum powder, inulin powder, and sweet whey powder together.
Add the resulting powder to the skimmed milk.
Using an electric mixer, whip for 2 minutes until the product has turned to a fine foam. While whipping, move the whisks up and down so that air gets whipped into the shake.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Super Moist Corn Bread

ingredients.name: melted butter or olive oil
ingredients.original: ¼ cup melted butter or olive oil

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). If using a Dutch oven, preheat with 16–18 glowing charcoal briquettes, with 3 times as many on the top as on the bottom.
In a large bowl, mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and brown sugar, if used.
In another bowl, whisk together the milk, yogurt, egg, and melted butter or olive oil.
Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and stir until just combined, no longer.
Immediately pour into the greased pan and bake for 15–20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Supercharger Tea
steps: Place tea bags in French press or coffee pot. Make sure to keep the strings taut to prevent the paper weights from falling in.
Pour the hot water into French press. Place lid on top, with a tight grip on the paper weights.
Let the tea steep for 5 minutes.
If using a French press, slowly push the plunger onto the bags, again with a tight grip on the paper weights.
Take off the lid, scoop the teabags out, and gently squeeze the brew from the bags before disposing of them.
Add sweetener and stir thoroughly.
Let tea cool to room temperature. Serve over ice, or place open pot in freezer for 70 minutes for quicker cooling. Stir in milk or citrus juice before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Superkanja (Gambian Okra Stew)

ingredients.name: lean beef, cut into chunks
ingredients.original: 2 lbs lean beef, cut into chunks

ingredients.name: smoked catfish or any fish of your choice
ingredients.original: 1 lb smoked catfish or any fish of your choice

ingredients.name: okra, diced into small cubes
ingredients.original: 2 lbs okra, diced into small cubes

steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the meat and fish. Let them boil for 15 minutes, then remove the fish from the pot.
To the pot, add salt, onions, pepper, and diced okra. Mix all the ingredients well.
Cook the mixture over medium heat for 15 minutes, then incorporate the palm oil.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Afterward, return the fish to the pot and continue simmering for 6–10 minutes on low heat.
Serve the superkanja stew with white rice or fufu.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Suqaar (Somali Spiced Meat Stir-fry)

ingredients.name: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.original: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish

steps: In a large skillet or frying pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the finely chopped onion to the hot oil and sauté until it becomes soft and translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the thinly sliced beef to the pan and cook until it browns and develops a nice sear on both sides.
Toss in the diced tomato and thinly sliced bell pepper. Continue to stir-fry until the vegetables soften slightly.
Sprinkle the ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper over the meat and vegetables. Mix well to evenly coat everything with the spices.
Season with salt to taste, adjusting the seasoning according to your preference.
Lower the heat to medium-low, cover the skillet, and let the suqaar simmer for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the meat to become tender.
Once the meat is fully cooked and tender, remove the skillet from the heat.
Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Surinamese Cassava and Coconut Dessert (Bojo)
steps: Peel and grate the cassava. Grate the white coconut meat.
Beat the eggs and sugar until firm. Add the vanilla and almond essence.
Combine the eggs and sugar with the grated coconut and cassava.
Add the cinnamon, milk, raisins and salt.
Melt the butter and add it to the mixture.
Rub the dish you want to use with butter or use Pam.
Put the mixture in the dish. Put the dish in a pre-heated oven at 350°F (175°C). Bake the Bojo for about an hour. It needs to be firm on top but not dry on the inside.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Surinamese Chicken Pot Pie (Pastei)

ingredients.name: pieces of chicken (drumstick, thigh, breast, etc.)
ingredients.original: 3 large pieces of chicken (drumstick, thigh, breast, etc.)

ingredients.name: Salt or bouillon cubes
ingredients.original: Salt or bouillon cubes to taste

ingredients.name: fresh chile pepper or bell pepper
ingredients.original: 1 fresh chile pepper or bell pepper (optional)

steps: Dough: Cream the butter with an electric mixer or a wooden spoon. Keep adding little bits of the water until the butter has absorbed it all.

Sift the flour, baking powder and the salt all together and add this through the butter gradually. To see if the dough is rollable, press your finger on it and if the dough doesn't stick to it, it's fine. However, if the dough does stick, add about 25 more grams of flour.
Divide the dough in half, then roll out each piece.
Line a buttered baking pan or aluminum foil pan with one sheet of dough. Press the dough to the corners of the pan so that as much filling as possible can go in.
Filling: Wash the chicken if necessary.
Simmer the chicken, 100 g butter, some of the chopped onion, 2–3 bouillon cubes, fresh pepper, bay leaf, and some allspice in about 1–1½ cups of water for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken, and strip it into little pieces, discarding the bones.
Put the rest of the butter in the broth in which the chicken had been boiled.
Heat a little oil in a frying pan, then add the remaining chopped onion.
Add the chicken. After a minute add the chopped tomatoes, the peas and carrots, and the celery. Every so often, add a little bit of the chicken broth to the pan so that it won't burn.
Add the chopped pickles.
After all the broth has been added and the whole seems good, taste to see if it has enough salt; if not, add some. Cool slightly, then mix in the ketchup and Worcestershire sauce.
Transfer the chicken mixture to the dough-lined pan until it is nicely filled.
Slice the boiled eggs and place them on top of the filling in the pan.
Top the mixture with the second sheet of dough. Seal the edges as best as possible.
Put the pastei in a preheated oven, and bake for about ¾ hour.
A few minutes before you take it out of the oven, you can lightly brush the top with some whisked egg to make the top shiny and a little crisp.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sushi Rice

ingredients.name: ō (300 g) uncooked, washed, short-grain Japanese rice
ingredients.original: 2 gō (300 g) uncooked, washed, short-grain Japanese rice

ingredients.name: metric tablespoons (45 ml) of rice vinegar
ingredients.original: 3 metric tablespoons (45 ml) of rice vinegar

ingredients.name: metric tablespoons (12–24 g) of sugar (depending on how sweet you prefer it)
ingredients.original: 1–2 metric tablespoons (12–24 g) of sugar (depending on how sweet you prefer it)

steps: About 30 minutes before starting, fill the hangiri with water and let it stand. The water saturates the wood, which prevents the rice from sticking to it.
Make the sushisu: Mix the vinegar, sugar, and salt. Heat the mixture in a saucepan until everything is dissolved, but do not boil. Set aside to cool.

Rinse the rice. Put the rice in the cooking pot, half filled with cold water, and swirl it around with your hand. The water will turn chalky white. Carefully drain off the water, and repeat the process several times, until the water remains clear.
Allow the rice to stand for 30 minutes. Some recipes say the rice should remain in the cooking pot submerged in its cooking water; others say to transfer it temporarily to a colander to drain.
Add an 8 cm-sized sheet of kombu to the cooking pot, along with the sake if you are using it.
Boil the water in the cooking pot.
Remove the kombu from the cooking pot just as the water boils, and reduce the heat. Simmer the water and rice in the cooking pot for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat but do not remove cover from the cooking pot for 10 minutes (no peeking).
Transfer the rice from the cooking pot to the hangiri; if you do not have one, use a large bowl or cookie sheet.

Cut the sushisu gently into rice with the paddle, trying not to break the kernels. For Western chefs: this "cutting" motion is similar to the cut-and-fold used for gentle treatment of egg whites. When finished, the rice is evenly coated with the dressing, giving it a shiny appearance.
Cover the rice with a cloth for a couple of minutes so the dressing is absorbed.
Cool the rice to body temperature by fanning it, while continuing to cut it with the spatula. A traditional hand fan or modern battery-powered fan may be used.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Svelekake (Norwegian Yogurt Pancakes)
steps: Mix all ingredients gently (do not use mixer).
Let batter stand ½ hour.
Fry on hot griddle.
Serve with butter, brunost (brown/goat cheese), or Nugatti Crisp (caramel/hazelnut dessert spread).

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Swedish Cabbage Soup (Kålsoppa)
steps: Quarter the head of cabbage. Remove the inner stem.
Slice the cabbage across into 3 mm, or thinner, strips.
In a cast-iron pot, melt some butter and add the onions. Cook until softened.
Add the sliced cabbage, and cook until slightly browned.
Add stock, covering the cabbage. Season with salt, white pepper, and 12 whole allspice kernels.
Boil the soup gently for 30–45 minutes.
Serve with hard flatbread, butter, and cheese.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs I

ingredients.name: liquid, such as water, milk or cream
ingredients.original: 200–300 ml (¾–1¼ cups) liquid, such as water, milk or cream

ingredients.name: onion, finely chopped or grated
ingredients.original: 1 small onion, finely chopped or grated

steps: Combine the liquid and bread crumbs in a bowl, and let it sit for 7–8 minutes.
Mix in the ground beef, ground pork, egg, onion, salt, and pepper.
Shape the mixture into round meatballs, approximately 2–3 centimeters (1 inch) in diameter.

Pan fry the meatballs on medium heat in a frying pan with butter for approximately 3–5 minutes. Fry them on all sides until they are brown and not pink in the middle. Shaking the pan occasionally will help the meatballs cook evenly.
Serve them with mashed potatoes with a veal based brown sauce made with cream and lingonberry preserve or cranberry preserve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs II

ingredients.name: instant coffee (can be omitted or sliced mushrooms can be used instead)
ingredients.original: 1 tsp instant coffee (can be omitted or sliced mushrooms can be used instead)

steps: Meatballs: Combine the ground beef, veal, and pork.
Soak breadcrumbs in milk.
Cook onion in butter until tender.
Combine meat, soaked bread crumbs, cooked onion, half-and-half, parsley, salt, ginger, and pepper.
Shape the mixture into meatballs, about 1 inch in diameter.
Very lightly brown the meatballs in a pan over medium heat. Remove meatballs from the pan, and reserve.
Gravy: After lightly browning meatballs, stir the flour into the meatball drippings in the pan, then add the half-and-half, butter, and coffee. Heat and stir until thickened.
Either add meatballs and gravy to a slow cooker and simmer until ready to eat, or add meatballs to sauce in pan and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Chinese Pork

ingredients.name: America's cut pork (boneless loin roast) per person, cut in 1-inch squares and pounded flat
ingredients.original: 1 America's cut pork (boneless loin roast) per person, cut in 1-inch squares and pounded flat

ingredients.name: dry sherry or Chinese rice wine
ingredients.original: 3 tbsp dry sherry or Chinese rice wine

ingredients.name: hot pepper or chili-garlic sauce
ingredients.original: ½ tsp hot pepper or chili-garlic sauce

ingredients.name: extra-light olive oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.original: ¼ cup extra-light olive oil or vegetable oil

steps: Mix the marinade ingredients in a large bowl and add the meat. Mix well to cover the meat and refrigerate for 2 hours (or overnight).
Combine sauce ingredients and set aside.
Remove pork from refrigerator and remove excess liquid (if any).
Beat egg and cornstarch and cover meat mixing well.
Place 2 tbsp oil in a wok and cook half the meat until no longer pink when slashed (about 2 minutes).
Remove meat, add remaining oil, and cook remaining meat.
Set cooked meat aside and discard pan drippings.
Add ginger and garlic to wok, stirring and cooking until fragrant.
Return pork to wok quickly stirring and add the sauce (stand back when adding sauce or it will really clear your sinuses).
Stir meat and sauce until meat is well covered, serve immediately.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Fish Casserole

ingredients.name: onions, sliced to make 1 cup
ingredients.original: 2–3 medium onions, sliced to make 1 cup

ingredients.name: white fish fillet (e.g., cod, haddock, hake, pollock)
ingredients.original: 500–700 g white fish fillet (e.g., cod, haddock, hake, pollock)

ingredients.name: parsley or cilantro sprig
ingredients.original: 2 Tbsp finely-chopped parsley or cilantro sprig (optional)

steps: Combine lemon juice, tomato paste, sugar and turmeric in small bowl, mix until smooth. Set this sauce aside.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Heat the oil in a large pot. Add the onions, and sauté until golden-brown and they begin to loosen their moisture. Then, remove using a slotted spoon, and layer in a oven-proof dish.
In the same oil, sauté the bell and chili peppers for 2 minutes or until softened, transfer using a slotted spoon to oven-proof dish, layering over the onions
Layer half of the raw tomatoes over the peppers.
Spread the garlic over the tomatoes, and season with half of the salt and pepper.
In the same oil, sauté the fish for 1 minute, then transfer to dish, place on top of tomatoes, season with remaining salt and pepper.
Top the fish with the remaining tomato slices. Spread the lemon-tomato-paste sauce over the top layer.
Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove aluminum foil, continue baking 10 more minutes, or until the fish flakes easily when tested.
Sprinkle with parsley or cilantro garnish, if desired.
Serve immediately.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Grilled Tuna

ingredients.name: ahi tuna loin, cut into 2 pieces
ingredients.original: 2 pounds ahi tuna loin, cut into 2 pieces

steps: Combine ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar. Reserve ¼ cup and add tuna to larger amount of mixture and toss to coat. Drain tuna and set aside.
Coat a sheet of newspaper with 1–2 tsp oil. Wad up and place under a good chimneyful of natural chunk charcoal. Light and wait 15 minutes or until coals are coated with light gray ash.
Rub grate with remaining oil and place on heated chimney. Add tuna and cook 15–30 seconds or until desired doneness is achieved.
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Let rest 3 minutes.
Slice thinly across the grain and serve with reserved marinade, or wrap tightly with a new sheet of plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 3 days.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Pork Loin

ingredients.name: ea. (4 pounds / 1.8 kg) boneless pork loin roast
ingredients.original: 1 ea. (4 pounds / 1.8 kg) boneless pork loin roast

steps: Combine salt, honey, water, and coconut milk in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add pork roast and toss to coat; refrigerate 2½–3 hours.
Drain pork and pat dry with paper towels. Discard remaining brine.
Combine ketchup, vinegar, oil, and soy sauce. Toss pork roast in mixture and place on a roasting rack in a roasting pan.

Combine remaining ingredients and press into all sides of pork. Insert a probe thermometer into the center and bake in a 425°F (220°C) oven until internal temperature reaches 140°F (60°C) for medium rare.
Move to a plate and let rest 7 minutes. Serve warm with sweet and sour sauce on the side.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Sauce

ingredients.name: pineapple chunks in unsweetened juice
ingredients.original: 1 can (20 oz / 567 g) pineapple chunks in unsweetened juice

ingredients.name: Cooked meat (suggested: chicken or pork) or fish
ingredients.original: Cooked meat (suggested: chicken or pork) or fish (optional)

steps: Mix the brown sugar and corn starch in a saucepan.
Add the vinegar, soy sauce, and most of the pineapple juice
Heat to boiling while stirring constantly.
Reduce heat, then add pineapple chunks, cherries, celery, and cooked meat.
Cook until celery begins to soften.
Serve sauce with cooked rice.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet and Spicy Asian Chicken

ingredients.name: ea. (16 ounces) boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
ingredients.original: 4 ea. (16 ounces) boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1½-inch pieces

ingredients.name: frozen orange juice concentrate, heated to boiling
ingredients.original: ¼ cup frozen orange juice concentrate, heated to boiling

steps: Dip chicken pieces into eggs. Season liberally with poultry shake and dredge in cornmeal, then move to a plate and let rest 2–3 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat oil to 350°F. Add chicken pieces, working in batches if needed, and fry until golden brown and crispy on the outside, and internal temperature reaches 165°F and juices run clear. Drain on a cooling rack set above a half-sheet pan.
Combine remaining ingredients. Add chicken pieces and toss to coat.
Serve warm.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet and Spicy Shrimp

ingredients.name: frozen orange juice concentrate
ingredients.original: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate

steps: Dredge shrimp into flour then dip into cornmeal. Set aside 2–3 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a deep-fryer or a pot to 375°F. Add shrimp and fry until golden brown. Drain on a wire rack.
Meanwhile, heat remaining ingredients in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until boiling. Add shrimp and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Beef

ingredients.name: bacon drippings or vegetable oil
ingredients.original: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings or vegetable oil

steps: Add the bacon drippings/vegetable oil to a skillet over high heat. Add the beef to the skillet, and brown the meat on all sides. Do not cook completely through. Transfer meat to the slow cooker.
In a skillet, melt the butter. Add the onions, and fry until they begin to become transparent.
Combine all the ingredients except the meat in the skillet. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Stir together.
Cook on low for 2½–3½ hours.
Serve with mashed potatoes and honey carrots.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Carrot Juice
steps: Chop or grate the carrots.
Place carrots and sugar in a blender, and add a small amount of water as needed.
Blend this mixture until well-puréed.
Strain the carrot purée to obtain a pure juice.
Chill and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Charoset

ingredients.name: Juice and zest of ½ lemon
ingredients.original: Juice and zest of ½ lemon

ingredients.name: Juice and zest of ½ orange
ingredients.original: Juice and zest of ½ orange

steps: Mix apples, bananas, lemon juice, lemon zest, orange juice, orange zest, dates, and nuts in a bowl.
Add cinnamon, wine, and matzo meal, and blend thoroughly.
Mix in honey to taste.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Cornbread

ingredients.name: maple syrup
ingredients.original: ½ cup (160 g / 5.6 oz) maple syrup

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.original: ½ cup (90 g / 3.2 oz) brown sugar

ingredients.name: butter, softened
ingredients.original: ½ cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) butter, softened

steps: In a large bowl beat eggs lightly to break the yolks as one would for scrambled eggs, then mix in the butter. Soften the butter beforehand if you must by heating it a little.
The butter/egg mixture should be loose. Add the sugar and maple syrup, mix well, then add the salt to the liquid mixture.
Mix the cornmeal and baking powder, then blend them into the liquids.

Slowly add the flour as needed to reach a proper cake batter texture. This should be softer than a cookie dough, able to stick to the mixing spoon and come off in blobs. You may not need all of the flour, or may even need a little more based on your eggs and how closely you measured.
Pour into a greased pan, put into an oven heated to 200°C (400°F), and let bake for between 15–25 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Elderflower Kefir
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well and enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Italian Sausage Skillet

ingredients.name: rotini or other spiral pasta
ingredients.original: 2 cups (480 ml) rotini or other spiral pasta

ingredients.name: sweet Italian sausage links
ingredients.original: 12 oz (330 g) sweet Italian sausage links

ingredients.name: cut green Italian beans
ingredients.original: 14.5 oz (410 g) cut green Italian beans, drained

ingredients.name: shredded provolone or mozzarella
ingredients.original: 2 oz (55 g) shredded provolone or mozzarella

steps: Cook pasta and drain.
Meanwhile, brown sliced sausage in hot oil in large skillet for 5 minutes, then drain away the fat.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, and drained beans. Bring to boil, then reduce heat. Simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Stir in cooked pasta.
Sprinkle with cheese.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Lassi
steps: Combine all ingredients except ice in blender, and blend until smooth.
Add ice and continue blending until frothy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Mango Lassi

ingredients.name: mango nectar (strained puréed mango)
ingredients.original: 1 L (4 cups) mango nectar (strained puréed mango)

steps: Mix sugar with the mango nectar until dissolved.
Gradually add the milk to the yoghurt.
Mix together the mango and yoghurt mixtures.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Maple Barbecue Chicken
steps: Press rub into chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat grill to medium high.
Add chicken pieces and cook, turning often, 15 minutes.
Brush chicken liberally with 1 cup barbecue sauce and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165–170°F.
Remove to a platter and cover with aluminum foil and let rest 10 minutes.
Serve warm with remaining ½ cup barbecue sauce.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Masa Bites with Hazelnut Chocolate Dipping Sauce

ingredients.name: whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks
ingredients.original: ¼ cup whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks

ingredients.name: corn tortillas, torn into small pieces
ingredients.original: 20 corn tortillas, torn into small pieces

steps: Hazelnut chocolate dipping sauce: Combine syrups and vanilla.
Gently fold in whipped cream.
Refrigerate until needed.
Masa bites: Place milk, eggs, salt, and sugar with the tortillas in a food processor, and pulse until chunky paste is achieved.
Move to a mixing bowl and stir in the butter. Work fast to prevent melting.
Pour oil into a 6-quart Dutch oven and heat to 375°F.
Roll tortilla mixture into 1 to 1½-inch balls. Fry, 6–8 at a time, until crisp and golden brown, about 2–3 minutes.
Drain on a cooling rack set above a sheet pan and let cool 1–2 minutes.
Serve warm with the hazelnut chocolate dipping sauce.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Mole with Vanilla Bean Ice Cream

ingredients.name: semi-sweet dark chocolate bar, cut into pieces
ingredients.original: 4 ounces semi-sweet dark chocolate bar, cut into pieces

ingredients.name: high-quality vanilla bean ice cream
ingredients.original: 2 cups high-quality vanilla bean ice cream

steps: Wash, devein, and remove seeds from chile ancho.
Boil the chile, then blend with the smallest amount of water possible.
Strain off water.
In a saucepan, add pureed chile, piloncillo, clove, cinnamon and chocolate.
Boil for 3 minutes.
Remove clove.
To serve, allow vanilla ice cream to soften slightly in a bowl and stir in mole.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Omelette
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Crack the eggs and separate the egg yolk from the egg whites.
Place the egg whites into the bowl, and whip the egg whites with a whisk until soft and fluffy.
Briefly whisk the egg yolks, then gently fold them into the whipped whites.
Pour into a frying pan over low heat, and cook slowly on the stove until the bottom is golden brown.
Place the frying pan into the oven after taking it off the stove, and bake until it is golden brown on the top.
Pull out of the oven and unmold onto a plate.
Pour and spread the jam gently over the omelette. Sift some icing sugar over the top of it.
Enjoy!

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Onion Ranch Dressing
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Peach Cobbler
steps: Filling: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Combine granulated sugar and cornstarch in a mixing bowl.
Stir in peaches and lemon juice to make a sugary-brown syrup.
Bring the peach mixture to a boil in a saucepan, and simmer until it thickens. Transfer to a 2-quart casserole dish, and put into the oven.
Topping: Combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a mixing bowl. Stir, until well mixed.
Add shortening, and cut with a pastry blender until well mixed.
Mix in milk to make a ball of dough.
Assembly: Remove casserole dish from the oven. Add dough in spoon-sized dollops on top of fruit.
Return to 400°F oven. Bake for 25–30 minutes, until topping turns brown.
Serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Pork Condiment

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, neck, or belly
ingredients.original: 350 g (0.77 lb) pork shoulder, neck, or belly

steps: Mix the light soy sauce and sugar together in a bowl. Add pork and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 36–48 hours, in order to maintain the quality and the taste of the pork.
Steam the pork over boiling water for about 20 minutes. After the steaming is finished, let the pork rest for about 10 minutes.
Slice the pork into pieces.
Put the palm sugar into a pan, and stir it over a low heat until it melts. Simmer until the sugar browns. Add fish sauce and water all together.
Add the pork to the sauce, and mix well to coat.
Simmer the pork in the sauce for about 5–10 minutes, then mix the pork and the sauce together.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Crisp
steps: Blend all the base ingredients together until creamy and smooth.
Mix all the topping ingredients together in a bowl.
Transfer the sweet potato mixture to a large casserole dish.
Sprinkle on topping, and bake at 350°F until top crisps and hardens.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes Sautéed with Honey

ingredients.name: flavorless oil (such as canola oil)
ingredients.original: 1 tsp (5 g) flavorless oil (such as canola oil)

steps: Peel the sweet potato, then chop it into 1 cm (0.4 in) cubes. The pieces of sweet potato don't need to be exactly 1 cm on each side, but they should all be around that size to ensure even cooking. Discard the peel.
Heat a large frying pan on a stovetop burner over medium heat.
Mix the honey, salt, and paprika together in a small bowl.
Add the butter and oil to the pan, then wait for the butter to melt fully.
Add the potatoes to the pan and stir until evenly distributed around the pan. There shouldn't be any sweet potato chunks on top of each other.
Pour the honey mixture over the potatoes and stir until it's evenly distributed across all of the potato pieces.

Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring the sweet potatoes every other minute. It's important to stir the potato pieces in order to prevent them from burning on one side, but stirring them too frequently won't allow them to brown sufficiently, which is why it's important to stir once every 2 minutes or so.
Serve topped with extra salt to your liking and enjoy!

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Pumpkin Scones

ingredients.name: butter or margarine, softened slightly
ingredients.original: ¼ cup butter or margarine, softened slightly

ingredients.name: cooked, mashed butternut squash, pumpkin, or other squash
ingredients.original: 1 cup cooked, mashed butternut squash, pumpkin, or other squash

steps: Stir together the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda, salt, ground nutmeg and ground ginger.
In a separate bowl, beat butter and sugar together with an electric mixer.
Add in the egg and corn syrup, and mix with a spoon to prevent over-mixing.
Stir in the squash and half of the sifted dry ingredients.
Add the rest of the dry ingredients with just enough of the milk to make a soft dough. If it is too sticky to work, add a sprinkle (or two) of flour.
Knead only a little, gently, until you can pat it out into a big flat rectangle about ¾ inch thick.
Cut into 12 pieces with a floured knife. Transfer to a lightly greased oven tray.
Bake at 230°C (450°F) for 18 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Rice Fritters
steps: Combine rice, eggs, and sugar. Form into 3-inch balls. Dredge in flour and set aside 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 375°F. Add rice balls and, working in batches, fry until golden brown and heated through.
Drain fritters on a cooling rack set in a sheet pan.
If desired, dust with powdered sugar before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Rice I

ingredients.name: tins (about 2 1/2 cups / 600 g) evaporated milk
ingredients.original: 1½ tins (about 2 ½ cups / 600 g) evaporated milk

ingredients.name: tins (2 1/2 cups / 600 g) sweetened condensed milk
ingredients.original: 2 tins (2 ½ cups / 600 g) sweetened condensed milk

steps: Bring water to a boil. Add rice, and boil until very soft. Most of the water should be absorbed by the rice. Add more water if necessary.
Add evaporated milk, condensed milk, cinnamon sticks, and vanilla essence.
Cook over medium heat, stirring once in a while to prevent sticking, until mixture has thickened and reached a pudding-like consistency.
Remove from heat, and stir in raisins.
Let stand.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Rice II

ingredients.name: slivered almonds, toasted if desired
ingredients.original: ¼–½ cup slivered almonds, toasted if desired

steps: Wash rice, and transfer to a pot.
Add enough water to cover rice with water equal to the depth of the rice.
Add salt, saffron, sugar, and raisins.
Cook over high heat until water disappears and steam is rising from holes in the surface of the rice.
Reduce heat to warm. Add almonds.
Cover tightly and let stand for 20 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweet Southern Chicken Salad
steps: Add the chicken breasts to a small pot. Add enough water to cover.

Slice stalks of celery into large sticks. Add celery, bay leaves, teaspoon salt, and peppercorns to the pot. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, lower temperature and simmer for at least one hour. Chicken should be tender, and should pull apart easily.
Remove chicken from water. You may wish to reserve the water as a base for a stock or a soup.
Slice chicken into small bite-size cubes. Take care not to shred the chicken, because the salad should be chunky.

Put cut chicken into a medium-sized bowl. Add mayonnaise and chutney, one spoonful at a time until salad reaches correct consistency. The salad should be moist and chunky, not wet and mushy. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve by itself in a bowl, or on bread, biscuits, or croissants.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sweetened Mulling Spice Mix
steps: Combine all ingredients together.
Store in an airtight container.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Swiss Meringue
steps: Put the egg whites and sugar into a stainless steel bowl.
Place the bowl over simmering water and whip with a wire whisk until the mixture is 120°F (50°C).
Remove the bowl from the heat and continue whipping until the meringue is completely cool.
Use as desired or as directed in your recipe.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Swiss Meringue Buttercream

ingredients.name: white granulated or superfine sugar
ingredients.original: 300 g white granulated or superfine sugar

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, at room temperature and cut into small chunks
ingredients.original: 400 g unsalted butter, at room temperature and cut into small chunks

steps: Combine the egg whites and sugar in a heat-proof bowl.

Set the bowl over a pan of simmering water. Stir the mixture until the egg whites have warmed and the sugar is dissolved—rub a bit of the mixture between your fingers to make sure there are no grains of sugar left. Be careful not to let the egg whites cook.
Remove the egg whites from the heat, and whip them into a stiff-peaked meringue.
With the mixer running on medium-high, gradually add the chunks of butter. Wait until the previous piece is incorporated before adding the next one.
Beat in any desired flavorings.
Use buttercream as desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Swiss Pudding
steps: Butter a baking dish, and sprinkle with the breadcrumbs.
Combine the apples, a little butter, nutmeg, and sugar in a saucepan. Cook until softened.
Transfer the apples into the prepared dish.
Top apples with another layer of the crumbs, then add pieces of fresh butter on the top.
Bake in a slow oven for about 15 minutes, until it becomes a delicate brown.
Serve hot or cold.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Switchel (Ginger Water)

ingredients.name: (about 160 ml) apple cider vinegar
ingredients.original: ⅔ cup (about 160 ml) apple cider vinegar

steps: Dissolve sugar/syrup and ground ginger in the water.
Stir in the apple cider vinegar
Chill or serve over ice cubes. Shake well before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sydney Smith's Salad Dressing
steps: Pass the potatoes through a sieve or a ricer.
Combine potatoes and remaining ingredients. Mix well.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Beef Curry

ingredients.name: chile powder (adjust to taste)
ingredients.original: ½ teaspoon chile powder (adjust to taste)

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add the cloves, green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and bay leaves. Sauté for a minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until they turn golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and sauté for another 2 minutes until the raw smell disappears.
Add the beef cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Stir in the cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and chili powder. Cook for a couple of minutes to toast the spices.
Add the hatxora, chopped tomatoes and green chilies. Cook until the tomatoes are soft and the oil starts to separate from the mixture.
Pour in enough water to cover the beef, season with salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and let the curry simmer for about 1.5–2 hours or until the beef is tender and the flavors meld.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or naan.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Biryani

ingredients.name: Your choice of meat (e.g. chicken, lamb, or beef)
ingredients.original: Your choice of meat (e.g. chicken, lamb, or beef)

steps: Rinse the Basmati rice thoroughly and soak it in water for about 30 minutes. Drain the rice and set it aside.
In a large, heavy-bottomed pan or pot, heat the ghee over medium heat.
Add the whole cumin seeds, ginger-garlic paste, sliced onion, green cardamom, cinnamon pieces, bay leaves, cloves, and black peppercorns. Sauté until the onions turn golden brown and aromatic.
Add your meat to the pan and cook until it's no longer pink.
Add the drained rice to the pan and stir well, ensuring it's coated with the flavorful mixture.
Pour in enough water to cover the rice (typically about 4 cups of water for 2 cups of rice). Season with salt according to your taste.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 15–20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the water is absorbed.
While the rice is cooking, make shallow cuts (slits) on the green chilies to release their flavor.
Once the rice is done, remove it from heat and let it sit, covered, for a few more minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the aromatic Sylheti biryani hot, garnished with the slitted green chilies, a dash of Kewra water, and a sprinkle of rose water for a delightful touch.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Doner Kebab

ingredients.name: boneless meat (chicken, lamb, or beef)
ingredients.original: 500 g boneless meat (chicken, lamb, or beef), thinly sliced

ingredients.name: vegetables (e.g. lettuce, tomatoes, onions)
ingredients.original: Sliced vegetables (e.g. lettuce, tomatoes, onions) for serving

ingredients.name: Garlic, tomato, and naga sauce (extremely spicy)
ingredients.original: Garlic, tomato, and naga sauce (extremely spicy)

steps: In a bowl, combine yogurt, vegetable oil, minced garlic, chopped onion, shatkora, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to create the marinade.
Add the thinly sliced meat to the marinade, ensuring it's coated thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, allowing the flavours to meld.
Preheat your grill or stovetop grill pan over medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, creating kebabs.
Grill the kebabs for about 10–15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is cooked through and has a nicely charred exterior.
While the kebabs are cooking, warm the pita bread or flatbreads on the grill.
Once the kebabs are done, remove them from the skewers.
Serve the kebab by placing slices of grilled meat into warmed pita bread or flatbreads. Add sliced vegetables and drizzle with tahini sauce or yogurt-based sauce.
Roll up the bread to encase the filling, and enjoy your sylheti doner kebab!

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Fried Rice

ingredients.name: leftover cooked rice (cooked and cooled at least 12 hours in advance)
ingredients.original: 2 cups leftover cooked rice (cooked and cooled at least 12 hours in advance)

ingredients.name: Fresh cilantro leaves and spearmint for garnish
ingredients.original: Fresh cilantro leaves and spearmint for garnish

steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and sauté until it turns translucent.
Add the leftover cooked rice to the pan and stir well.
Season with salt according to your taste. Be cautious as the rice might already have some salt from the previous meal.
Cook for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is heated through and starts to turn slightly crispy.
Once done, remove from heat.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves if desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Handesh

ingredients.name: organic date syrup (traditional), molasses, or sugar
ingredients.original: 1 cup organic date syrup (traditional), molasses, or sugar

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the molasses and rice flour. Knead the mixture well until it forms a smooth, pliable dough. If the mixture is too dry, you can add a little water to achieve the desired consistency.
Heat cooking oil in a deep pan over medium-high heat.
Take small portions of the dough and shape them into round or oval discs, about the size of your palm.
Carefully slide the shaped dough into the hot oil and fry until it puffs up and turns golden brown. Be cautious when frying, as the oil will be very hot.
Remove the fried handesh from the oil and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Allow the handesh to cool slightly before serving. They can be enjoyed warm or at room temperature.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Onion and Rice Fritters
steps: Blend the onions, ginger, and garlic, then add them to a saucepan with the boiling water.
Season the mixture with salt and turmeric powder. Optionally incorporate panch puran.
Stir plain flour, rice flour, and/or ground rice into the saucepan, forming a spongy, soft paste.
Once the paste is fully cooked, remove it from the saucepan and let it cool.
Knead the paste on a floured surface until it comes together into a dough.
Flatten or roll out the dough, then cut out pieces.
Deep fry the dough pieces in hot oil, then drain and serve.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Rice Pudding
steps: Wash the rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, bring the milk (if using) to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and simmer over low heat, stirring constantly, until the rice is cooked and the mixture thickens. This may take about 1 hour.
Add sugar and cardamom powder, and continue to cook for another 10–15 minutes until the sugar is fully dissolved and the pudding thickens further.
Stir in the grated coconut and raisins.
Remove from heat.
Grease a serving dish with ghee and transfer the rice pudding to the dish.
Allow it to cool and set.
Serve chilled and enjoy.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Sylheti Tangy Curry

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil (e.g. canola, sunflower, or olive oil)
ingredients.original: Vegetable oil (e.g. canola, sunflower, or olive oil)

steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan.
Add the garlic, and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the onion paste and cook until it turns golden brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook until they become soft and the oil begins to separate.
Mix in turmeric and salt according to your taste.
Pour in the boiling water, and let the curry simmer until it reaches your desired consistency.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Szegedin Goulash

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into bite-sized cubes
ingredients.original: 600 g pork shoulder, cut into bite-sized cubes

steps: Heat the lard in a pot, then add the pork and sauté it for about 3 minutes. Take out the pork and set it aside on a plate.
Put the finely chopped onions into the casserole and fry until they become golden brown.

Stir in the tomato purée and paprika, and add some water or stock. Then add the meat, bay leaves and garlic; pour in more water or stock and season with salt and pepper. Reduce the heat and cook for about 30 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, and cook for another 40 minutes.
Add the sour cream, mix it thoroughly with the goulash, and serve it on warm plates.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh I
steps: Cover the wheat in boiling water and let stand for 5 minutes; drain.
Stir in lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper to wheat. Refrigerate while the rest of the vegetables are being chopped.
Core and finely chop the bell peppers.
Remove the larger stems from the parsley and finely chop.
Drop the tomatoes in boiling water for 20 seconds, then run under cold water, and the skins peel off easily.
Quarter the tomatoes and discard seeds. Chop finely.
Mix all vegetables along with olives and nutmeg into the wheat.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh II

ingredients.name: fresh parsley (preferably flat leaf), very finely chopped
ingredients.original: 1 bunch fresh parsley (preferably flat leaf), very finely chopped

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves
ingredients.original: ½ bunch fresh mint leaves, finely chopped

ingredients.name: salt, or
ingredients.original: ½ tsp salt, or to taste

ingredients.name: pepper, or
ingredients.original: ½ tsp pepper, or to taste

steps: Place the bulgur in the lemon juice and set aside for 15 minutes.
When the bulgur is soft, mix all the ingredients together, adding the olive oil last.
Toss well, and adjust the lemon juice as desired.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh III

ingredients.name: bulghur wheat (fine grind is best, medium grind acceptable)
ingredients.original: ½ cup bulghur wheat (fine grind is best, medium grind acceptable)

ingredients.name: parsley (flat leaf or curly Italian)
ingredients.original: 2 bunches parsley (flat leaf or curly Italian)

ingredients.name: Romaine lettuce leaves (garnish and scoopers, optional)
ingredients.original: Romaine lettuce leaves (garnish and scoopers, optional)

steps: Soak the bulghur wheat in at least three times its volume of cold water. Fine grind only needs a half hour of soaking. Medium grind needs longer. Bulghur wheat has already been parboiled before cracking or grinding, so it doesn’t need further cooking to be edible in tabbouli.
Drain bulghur.
Chop the parsley leaves, green onions, mint, tomatoes and cucumbers.
Chop the parsley quite fine, using a knife, not food processor.

Mix veggies and bulghur together. Douse with strained lemon juice. If you are not ready to serve immediately, then cover and hold in a cool place. Do NOT add salt and olive oil until immediately before serving.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh IV

ingredients.name: bulgur wheat (#2, medium grind)
ingredients.original: 1 cup (240 ml) bulgur wheat (#2, medium grind)

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.original: 1 cup (240 ml) fresh parsley, finely chopped

ingredients.name: fresh mint, finely chopped (do not use dried mint)
ingredients.original: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh mint, finely chopped (do not use dried mint)

ingredients.name: tomato, peeled, seeded, and diced
ingredients.original: 1 large tomato, peeled, seeded, and diced

ingredients.name: onion, grated on the large side of a box grater
ingredients.original: 1 medium onion, grated on the large side of a box grater

ingredients.name: scant ½ cup (100 ml) extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.original: scant ½ cup (100 ml) extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice
ingredients.original: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh lemon juice

steps: Soak bulgur in water for 15 minutes. Drain and squeeze out as much water as possible.
Chop the green onions, the white portion finely, the tops around medium.
Mix the bulgur, tomato, green onions, grated onion, parsley, and mint in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice together and pour over the salad. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Refrigerate for an hour or so to allow the flavors to meld.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh VI

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.original: 2 cups (480 ml) fresh parsley, finely chopped

ingredients.name: tomato, diced with seeds discarded
ingredients.original: 1 large tomato, diced with seeds discarded

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.original: ⅓ cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice
ingredients.original: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh lemon juice

steps: Boil 2–3 cups of water
Once water comes to a boil, add bulgur wheat and remove from heat. Let cool.
Drain the bulgur wheat, and mix wheat with all other ingredients.
Refrigerate.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Table Point Boiled Beef and Vegetables (Tafelspitz)

ingredients.name: fresh beef brisket, silverside, or sirloin
ingredients.original: 2½ pounds (1200 g) fresh beef brisket, silverside, or sirloin

ingredients.name: whole cloves garlic, slightly crushed and peeled
ingredients.original: 3 whole cloves garlic, slightly crushed and peeled

ingredients.name: whole green (freeze dried) or white peppercorns
ingredients.original: 3 whole green (freeze dried) or white peppercorns

ingredients.name: juniper berries (you may substitute with 1 bay leaf)
ingredients.original: 2 juniper berries (you may substitute with 1 bay leaf)

ingredients.name: ea. (4 oz / 110 g) whole medium size carrots, peeled and trimmed
ingredients.original: 3 ea. (4 oz / 110 g) whole medium size carrots, peeled and trimmed

ingredients.name: ea. (2 oz / 55 g) small-medium onion, unpeeled, trimmed, and halved
ingredients.original: 1 ea. (2 oz / 55 g) small-medium onion, unpeeled, trimmed, and halved

steps: Fill a 5-quart (700 ml) Dutch oven with water, season it with salt, and bring to a rolling boil over medium heat.
When the water boils, add meat, garlic, peppercorns, and juniper berries, then cover the pot.
Bring the water to a boil again and add carrots, onion, and parsley. Cover and let everything simmer for 60 minutes.
Turn the meat over, add salt, and let everything cook, covered, for 90 additional minutes.
Switch off the heat, and let the meat steep for 20 minutes.
Remove the meat from the broth and cut meat across the grain when you serve it.
Serve tafelspitz with apfelkren (see notes) and your choice of raw and cooked vegetables.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Taboon Bread
steps: Mix the dry ingredients together.
Add olive oil, then gradually knead in enough water to make a dough. Knead for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into balls, and allow them to rest for an hour until risen.
Sprinkle a flat working surface with flour, and roll the dough balls into flat, circular-shaped patties.
Preheat an oven containing a bed of smooth beach stones to 200°C (400°F). Alternatively, you can place the stones on a tray or pan in the oven.
Place the flat dough upon the stones, and bake for about 8 minutes until it produces bubbles.
Serve hot.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.attribution: Wikibooks contributors · CC BY-SA 4.0; adapted for Mise.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
steps: Brown the ground beef in skillet on medium heat.
Drain the ground beef.
Dump the ground beef back in the skillet.
